VehicleZone
VehicleZone is a base class for defining spatial zones in the vehicle system. Zones can be used to trigger or modify vehicle behavior (AI, audio, damage, weather, etc.) when a vehicle enters or interacts with them. This class manages the zone's collider (box or sphere), its type, and provides utility methods for collider management and editor visualization.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-base-vehiclezone-zoneshape](ZoneShape) The geometric shape of the zone's collider.
[#mvc-base-vehiclezone-zonetype](ZoneType) The functional type of the zone, indicating what system it affects.
Fields
Name Description
boxCollider Cached reference to the BoxCollider, if present.
collider The collider used by this zone.
containerInstance Cached reference to the parent VehicleZonesContainer, if any.
shape The current shape of the zone (serialized for inspector).
sphereCollider Cached reference to the SphereCollider, if present.
type The current type of the zone (cached).
Methods
Name Description
OnDestroy Unity event called when the component is destroyed. Cleans up the collider if present.
OnDrawGizmosSelected Draws gizmos in the editor to visualize the zone's shape and size when selected.
OnEnable Unity event called when the component is enabled. Ensures the collider is created and up to date.
RecreateCollider Recreates the collider for this zone based on the current shape. Destroys any existing collider and adds a new one of the appropriate type. Sets collider properties such as hideFlags and isTrigger.
ZoneShape
The geometric shape of the zone's collider.
Fields
Name Description
Box The zone uses a BoxCollider.
Sphere The zone uses a SphereCollider.
ZoneType
The functional type of the zone, indicating what system it affects.
Fields
Name Description
AI Zone affects AI behavior.
Audio Zone affects audio.
Damage Zone affects vehicle damage.
Unknown Unknown or unspecified zone type.
Weather Zone affects weather.
VehicleZonesContainer
Container component that manages and creates various types of vehicle zones. This component serves as a parent container for organizing different zone types such as AI zones, audio zones, damage zones, and weather zones.

Core
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehicle](Vehicle) Vehicle module extension that owns shared wheel-ground loop audio for all wheels.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera](VehicleCamera) Represents a camera configuration for a vehicle, supporting both follower and pivot camera types. Provides extensive customization for camera features, orbiting, field of view, shaking, and impact response. This class is serializable and can be used as a component in Unity's toolkit system.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecameraaccess](VehicleCameraAccess) A struct providing fast, value-type access to a VehicleCamera's settings. Useful for performance-critical code or interop scenarios.
[#mvc-core-vehiclechassis](VehicleChassis) Partial class containing wing module functionality for the VehicleChassis.
[#mvc-core-vehiclechassiswingbehaviour](VehicleChassisWingBehaviour) Legacy enum for wing behavior types. This has been replaced by VehicleChassis.WingModule.Behaviour.
[#mvc-core-vehicledifferential](VehicleDifferential) Partial class containing temporary variables for the VehicleDifferential system. This class holds runtime state variables that are updated during differential calculations and represent the current state of the differential outputs.
[#mvc-core-vehicledifferentialaccess](VehicleDifferentialAccess) Internal struct that provides read-only access to VehicleDifferential properties and variables. This struct is used to efficiently pass differential data to jobs and other systems without requiring direct access to the VehicleDifferential component.
[#mvc-core-vehicledifferentialtype](VehicleDifferentialType) Legacy enum for differential types. This enum is obsolete and should not be used in new code. Use instead.
[#mvc-core-vehicledrivetraincomponent](VehicleDrivetrainComponent) Abstract base class for all vehicle drivetrain components (e.g., differentials, transfer cases, etc.). This class defines the core interface and shared properties for drivetrain elements that process and distribute torque, angular velocity, and inertia within a vehicle's powertrain system. It is intended to be inherited by concrete drivetrain implementations that handle the logic for splitting or redirecting torque between outputs (such as left/right wheels or front/rear axles).
[#mvc-core-vehicleenginechassistorque](VehicleEngineChassisTorque) Legacy enum for engine torque effect on chassis. This has been replaced by VehicleChassis.EngineTorqueEffect.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower](VehicleFollower) Main vehicle follower camera system that handles camera positioning, rotation, and field of view adjustments.
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper](VehicleGroundMapper) VehicleGroundMapper is responsible for mapping ground types and properties for a vehicle in the Multiversal Vehicle Controller system. It detects the type of ground (terrain or collider), manages the mapping between ground layers and ground settings, and ensures that the correct physical material and ground indices are set up for the vehicle's interaction with the environment. This class is intended to be attached to GameObjects representing ground surfaces.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel](VehicleWheel) Represents a single vehicle wheel, handling its physics, visuals, and damage state. This class manages the wheel's collider, friction, health, and associated renderers and effects.

[#mvc-core-editor-vehicleconfigpreset](VehicleConfigPreset) A portable, tuning-only snapshot of a vehicle's configuration. Carries plain numbers, enumerators and curves; scene references and project assets are excluded by design, with engine, charger and tire compound selections travelling by name so they can be re-resolved elsewhere.
[#mvc-core-editor-vehicleconfigsection](VehicleConfigSection) The tuning sections a vehicle configuration file can carry. Mirrors the foldouts of the vehicle inspector so the import/export checkboxes read the same as the editor.
[#mvc-core-editor-vehicleconfigsections](VehicleConfigSections) Presentation helpers for .
[#mvc-core-editor-vehicleconfigselection](VehicleConfigSelection) The state of an in-progress vehicle configuration import or export. Held by the inspector for as long as the user is choosing sections; a null instance means the inspector is in its normal mode.
[#mvc-core-editor-wheelpreset](WheelPreset) A serializable snapshot of the portable tuning of a single wheel. The wheel's transforms, renderers and mesh bounds are excluded; the material indices into those renderers are not, since they are plain numbers that mean the same thing on any rig.

VehicleConfigPreset
A portable, tuning-only snapshot of a vehicle's configuration. Carries plain numbers, enumerators and curves; scene references and project assets are excluded by design, with engine, charger and tire compound selections travelling by name so they can be re-resolved elsewhere.
Fields
Name Description
sections The mask describing which sections this file actually carries. Required because cannot distinguish an absent object from a zeroed one.

WheelPreset
A serializable snapshot of the portable tuning of a single wheel. The wheel's transforms, renderers and mesh bounds are excluded; the material indices into those renderers are not, since they are plain numbers that mean the same thing on any rig.
Vehicle
Vehicle module extension that owns shared wheel-ground loop audio for all wheels.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehicle-aspiration](Aspiration) Defines the engine's air intake system that affects power delivery and sound. The aspiration method significantly impacts torque curve, power delivery, throttle response, and engine sound. Used to configure engine performance characteristics and audio behavior.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-audiomixersmodule](AudioMixersModule) Manages audio mixer groups and volume settings for various vehicle sound components.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-behaviouraccess](BehaviourAccess) Provides read-only access to vehicle behavior properties for efficient data transfer.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-behaviourmodule](BehaviourModule) Represents the behavior module of a vehicle, managing engine characteristics, power delivery, fuel consumption, forced induction systems, and various vehicle performance parameters. This module serves as the core component for defining how a vehicle behaves in terms of power output, torque curves, fuel efficiency, and special features like NOS and regenerative braking.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-brakeaccess](BrakeAccess) Provides read-only access to brake module properties. Acts as a data transfer object for brake-related information.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-brakemodule](BrakeModule) Represents a vehicle brake system with configurable properties. Handles brake type, physical properties, and torque calculations.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-carclass](CarClass) Defines the different classes of cars with unique handling and performance characteristics. Each class has specific default settings for suspension, power delivery, and handling dynamics. Used to quickly configure vehicles with appropriate baseline characteristics.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-driverikmodule](DriverIKModule) The DriverIKModule class manages the Inverse Kinematics (IK) setup for a vehicle's driver, including hand and foot pivots for animation and interaction with vehicle controls. It provides properties to access and modify IK pivots, driver assignment, and validation checks for the module's configuration.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-heavytruckclass](HeavyTruckClass) Defines the different classes of heavy trucks with unique handling and performance characteristics. Each class has specific default settings for load capacity, power delivery, and handling dynamics. Used to quickly configure heavy vehicles with appropriate baseline characteristics.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-inputsaccess](InputsAccess) Manages all vehicle input handling including keyboard, gamepad, and mobile controls. Provides access to input states, processes input values, and handles haptic feedback (rumble). This struct is responsible for: - Processing raw input values from different input systems - Managing input state transitions (pressed/released) - Handling input overrides for AI or scripted control - Calculating and applying gamepad rumble effects based on vehicle state - Supporting multiple input systems (Unity Input, InputsManager, Mobile)
[#mvc-core-vehicle-problemsaccess](ProblemsAccess) A readonly struct that provides access to vehicle problem detection and validation functionality. This class is responsible for identifying various issues, errors, and warnings in vehicle configuration and provides methods to disable the vehicle when critical problems are detected.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet](SFXSheet) Manages all sound effects for the vehicle, including engine, exhaust, turbocharger, supercharger, transmission, impacts, and other vehicle-related audio.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-stabilityaccess](StabilityAccess) A read-only structure that provides efficient access to stability settings. This struct is optimized for marshaling between managed and unmanaged code, allowing stability settings to be efficiently passed to native code components. It serves as an immutable snapshot of a StabilityModule's current state.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-stabilitymodule](StabilityModule) The StabilityModule class manages all vehicle stability control systems and physics properties. This includes anti-sway bars, ABS, ESP, TCS, steering helpers, weight distribution, downforce, and drag properties. It provides a comprehensive set of parameters to fine-tune vehicle handling characteristics.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-statsaccess](StatsAccess) StatsAccess provides a comprehensive data structure for tracking and calculating various vehicle statistics. It stores information about wheel positions, velocities, friction values, ground contact data, and other vehicle performance metrics. This struct is designed to be used with Unity's Job System for efficient parallel processing of vehicle physics calculations.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-steeringaccess](SteeringAccess) Provides read-only access to steering module data for performance-critical operations. This struct contains a snapshot of steering configuration values optimized for fast access.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-steeringmodule](SteeringModule) Manages vehicle steering behavior including steering methods, angles, and dynamic steering features. Provides configuration for different steering algorithms and steering angle calculations.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-train](Train) Defines the drivetrain configuration that determines which wheels receive power. This configuration significantly affects vehicle handling, traction, and performance characteristics. Used throughout the physics simulation to determine power distribution and traction modeling.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-transmissionaccess](TransmissionAccess) Provides read-only access to transmission module data for efficient vehicle simulation. This struct encapsulates all transmission-related properties and arrays needed for vehicle physics calculations, gear shifting, and performance optimization. Implements IDisposable to properly manage native array memory allocation.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-transmissionmodule](TransmissionModule) Manages the transmission system of a vehicle, including gear ratios, shifting behavior, and differential configurations. This module handles both manual and automatic transmissions, supports single and double gearbox systems for AWD vehicles, and provides comprehensive gear management with automatic ratio calculation capabilities.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-vfxsheet](VFXSheet) Manages all visual effects for the vehicle including exhaust effects, collision sparks, and NOS flames. This class handles particle system creation, management, and real-time updates for various VFX elements.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-vehicletype](VehicleType) Defines the main categories of vehicles supported by the controller. This enum is used throughout the system to determine appropriate physics models, handling characteristics, and available configuration options.

Methods
Name Description
ABS Applies anti-lock braking system (ABS) logic to all wheels. Prevents wheel lockup by modulating brake torque based on slip.
ABS(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel) Applies ABS logic to a single wheel. Modulates brake torque if slip exceeds the ABS threshold.
AddFuel(System.Single) Adds fuel to the current tank level and clamps the result to the configured tank capacity.
AddNOS(System.Single) Adds to the vehicle's total nitrous oxide supply and clamps it to the installed capacity.
Aerodynamics Applies aerodynamic effects to the vehicle, including drag and downforce. Drag is proportional to speed; downforce is applied at front and rear axles.
AntiSwayBars Simulates anti-sway (anti-roll) bars to reduce body roll during cornering. Applies forces to the chassis based on wheel travel differences and slip.
ApplyCounterSteerHelper(System.Single@) Applies the counter-steer helper to the given steer angle, using the vehicle's full steer envelope.
ApplyCounterSteerHelper(System.Single@, System.Single) Applies the counter-steer helper to the given steer angle, modifying it based on vehicle and settings state.
ArcadeSteerHelpers Applies arcade-style steering helpers to assist with vehicle control. Modifies angular and linear velocity to help the vehicle turn more responsively.
AspirationBoost Handles boost from turbochargers and superchargers. Calculates engine boost value based on aspiration type, RPM, and settings.
AutoGearboxShiftUpDown(System.Single) Handles automatic up/down gear shifting based on speed and engine RPM.
AverageAngularVelocity(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[]) Averages the angular velocity of a group of wheels, in radians per second, sampled from the physics engine rather than from the wheels' own cache, which this method runs too early in the frame to see updated.
AverageInertia(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[]) Averages the rotational inertia of a group of wheels, in kg·m².
Awake Unity's lifecycle method override. Ensures the vehicle is initialized and restarted when the component is first loaded.
AxleDriveRatio(System.Boolean) Calculates the total reduction ratio between the engine-side differential frame and the wheels of an axle, combining the selected gearbox ratio (which already includes the final drive) with the differential gear ratios along the path.
BoostNOS Handles the nitrous oxide (NOS) boost system, including activation, consumption, and regeneration. Also manages visual effects and progressive boost if enabled.
Brakes Applies brake torque to all wheels based on input and drivetrain configuration. Handles both front and rear brakes, as well as handbrake and special cases for trailers.
Burnouts Calculates burnout intensity based on drivetrain, TCS, transmission, and input conditions. Burnout intensity is used to modulate engine and handling behavior.
ChangeGear(System.Int32, System.Boolean) Coroutine to handle the gear change process, including delays, sound effects, and state updates.
ChassisTorque Applies engine torque effect to the chassis for realism (e.g., torque twist). Only applies if enabled and not for certain engine/drivetrain layouts.
CounterSteer Applies counter-steer assistance to help stabilize the vehicle during oversteer. Adjusts the counterSteerHelper value based on rear wheel slip and settings.
DetectFollowerImpactShaking Detects impact camera shake by comparing current target rigidbody velocity against a short rolling sample window.
Donuts Simulates "donut" maneuvers (spinning the car in place) by applying torque and force at calculated positions. Only applies if the vehicle is RWD/AWD, not stationary, and handling rate is appropriate.
Drift Simulates drifting by applying lateral and longitudinal forces based on rear wheel slip. Only applies if the vehicle is RWD/AWD, not stationary, and handling rate is less than 1.
ESP Applies electronic stability program (ESP) logic to help prevent skidding and loss of control. Modulates brake torque on individual wheels based on vehicle yaw angle and speed.
EnterRootTransformEditMode Suspends root transform simulation so the vehicle can be repositioned manually at runtime.
ExitRootTransformEditMode Restores physics simulation after runtime root transform editing.
FixedUpdate Unity's FixedUpdate method for physics-based updates. Handles all per-physics-tick vehicle simulation, including input processing, engine, handling, and stability systems.
Fuel Calculates and applies fuel consumption for the current physics tick. Handles both combustion and electric vehicles, including regenerative braking.
GearBox Handles all gearbox logic, including automatic, semi-automatic, and manual shifting, as well as AI and input-based gear requests.
GearShiftSpeed(System.Int32) Calculates the speed threshold for shifting gears.
GearShiftUpEffects Plays sound and visual effects for an upshift, such as turbo/supercharger blowout and exhaust flames. Chargers only blow off once they are spooled up, while exhaust flames are exclusive to redline shifts.
GetNOSReady Coroutine to handle NOS activation delay (if enabled). Plays NOS start sound and waits for the configured delay before activating NOS.
GetOrCreateRigidbody Retrieves the Rigidbody component attached to this GameObject, or creates one if it does not exist. Configures the Rigidbody with appropriate settings for the vehicle, including mass, drag, and velocity. Returns the configured Rigidbody, or null if the vehicle has internal errors.
IgnoreCollisionsWithOtherVehicles(System.Boolean) Updates every non-trigger vehicle collider so contacts with the configured vehicle and wheel layers are either excluded or restored to their original exclusion masks.
Initialize Resets and clears all relevant fields, references, and temporary data for the vehicle. This method is used internally to ensure a clean state before reinitialization.
LateUpdate Called every frame after all Update functions have been called. Handles weather zone refresh, input updates, SFX/VFX updates, and interior updates (if enabled). - Skips if the vehicle is not "awakened" (active/initialized). - Refreshes weather zone status (darkness/fog). - For non-trailer vehicles: - Updates AI inputs if AI is enabled. - Updates input state if AI input was updated. - Updates sound effects (SFX). - Updates interior (if enabled and not in community version). - Updates visual effects (VFX) for all vehicles.
LaunchControl Handles launch control logic, toggling launch control state based on input and vehicle speed.
LightInputs Handles all lighting input logic, including headlights, high beams, interior lights, and signal lights. Also synchronizes lighting state with trailers if attached.
OnCollisionEnter(UnityEngine.Collision) Unity event called when this vehicle collides with another collider. Handles damage logic and collision SFX/VFX. - Skips if not awakened, damage is disabled, or the collision layer is not in the damage mask. - Triggers SFX for car or wall impacts based on collision layer. - Triggers VFX (sparks) if enabled.
OnCollisionExit(UnityEngine.Collision) Unity event called when this vehicle stops colliding with another collider. Handles cleanup of collision VFX (sparks).
OnDestroy Unity event called when the component is destroyed. Handles cleanup and disposal of all resources, including rigidbody, SFX, VFX, and data containers.
OnDisable Unity event called when the component is disabled. Handles stopping engine start SFX if the engine is not running.
OnDrawGizmosSelected Draws custom gizmos in the Unity Editor when the vehicle is selected. This method visualizes important vehicle features such as exhausts, lights, center of mass, and trailer link points for easier debugging and setup.
OnEnable Unity event called when the component is enabled. Calls Awake() to initialize the vehicle if needed.
OnTriggerEnter(UnityEngine.Collider) Unity event called when another collider enters this vehicle's trigger collider. Handles weather zone and damage zone registration. - For non-trailer vehicles, adds weather zones (darkness/fog) to the relevant lists. - For all vehicles, adds damage zones to all wheels if present.
OnTriggerExit(UnityEngine.Collider) Unity event called when another collider exits this vehicle's trigger collider. Handles weather zone and damage zone deregistration. - Removes weather zones (darkness/fog) from the relevant lists. - Removes damage zones from all wheels if present.
RefillFuelTank Refills the vehicle's fuel tank to its maximum capacity. Does nothing if the vehicle is a trailer.
RefillNOS Refills the complete nitrous oxide supply and recalculates the amount stored per bottle.
RefreshAIBehaviours Refreshes the list of AI behaviours attached to this vehicle and updates AI state flags.
RefreshBounds Calculates and updates the bounds (AABB) for the vehicle and its chassis. Also updates the center of mass interval for use in physics calculations.
RefreshGearShiftRPMFactor Calculates the RPM factor for gear shifting based on the torque curve and transmission settings.
RefreshIKPivots Refreshes the IK pivot transforms for the vehicle, creating a parent object if necessary. Applies hide flags if specified in settings. Does nothing for trailers.
RefreshLayersAndTags Ensures that the vehicle and all its child objects are set to the correct layers and tags. This is important for collision, rendering, and game logic.
RefreshPendingJobData Applies pending configuration changes before any job can observe the cached data.
RefreshTargetSpeeds Updates the target speeds and gear ratio for the current gear and direction.
RefreshWeatherZones Checks and updates the vehicle's status regarding weather zones (darkness and fog). Sets flags in stats for whether the vehicle is currently inside a darkness or fog weather zone. Iterates through all registered weather zones and checks for intersection with the vehicle's world bounds.
RefreshWeightHeight Refreshes the weight height value for the vehicle using the current Stability module.
RefreshWeightHeight(MVC.Core.Vehicle.StabilityModule) Calculates and updates the weight height value for the vehicle, using the provided stability module. This is used for physics and stability calculations.
RefreshWheels Rebuilds all wheel arrays and recalculates wheel positions, axle balance, and drivetrain/steertrain configuration. This method is essential after any change to the wheel setup.
RefreshWheelsRenderers Refreshes the renderers for all wheels in the editor (not during play mode). This ensures that wheel visuals are up to date after changes in the editor.
RequestChangeGear(System.Int32, System.Boolean) Requests a gear change, stopping any ongoing gear shift coroutine and starting a new one.
RequestGearShiftDown Requests a gear shift down on the next gearbox update.
RequestGearShiftToForward Requests a shift to forward gear on the next gearbox update.
RequestGearShiftToNeutral Requests a shift to neutral gear on the next gearbox update.
RequestGearShiftToReverse Requests a shift to reverse gear on the next gearbox update.
RequestGearShiftUp Requests a gear shift up on the next gearbox update.
RequestSearchGear(System.Single, System.Single, System.Boolean) Requests a search for the appropriate gear based on speed and factor, starting a coroutine.
Reset Unity event called to reset the component to its initial state. Ensures the rigidbody is created or reset if the vehicle setup is complete.
ResetImpactDetection Clears velocity history and cooldown state for impact shake detection.
ResetVehicle Resets the vehicle's position, orientation, wheels, and physics state. Also resets input state and mesh visibility for a visual reset effect.
ResetWeightHeight [Obsolete] Use RefreshWeightHeight instead.
Restart Restarts the vehicle and all its major components, including lights, chassis, AI behaviours, trailer links, wheels, and optionally interior and wheel spins. This method is typically called on initialization or when a full reset is required.
RestartAlone Performs a partial restart of the vehicle, reinitializing core fields and refreshing wheels, AI behaviours, and other subsystems. This method is called internally by and can be used for more granular control over the vehicle's reset process.
ResumeRootTransformEditModeAudio Restores all vehicle audio sources after root transform edit mode ends.
SearchGear(System.Single, System.Single, System.Boolean) Coroutine to search for the appropriate gear based on speed and factor, then shift to it.
SetFuelTank(System.Single) Replaces the current fuel level with a value constrained by the configured tank capacity.
SetNOS(System.Single) Replaces the total nitrous oxide supply with a value constrained by the installed capacity.
SetStability(MVC.Core.Vehicle.StabilityModule) Sets the stability module for this vehicle.
StallEngine Forces the engine to stall, disabling running and starting states.
StartEngine Coroutine for starting the engine, including sound effects and delays for realism.
StartOrShutEngine Handles logic for starting or shutting down the engine, including auto-shutdown and input-based start.
Steer Calculates and applies steering angles to all steerable wheels. Handles steering interpolation, Ackermann geometry, and counter-steer helpers.
StoreImpactVelocitySample(Unity.Mathematics.float3, System.Single) Stores a rigidbody velocity sample in the impact detection ring buffer.
SuspendRootTransformEditModeAudio Pauses all vehicle audio sources while root transform edit mode is active.
TCS(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel) Applies traction control system (TCS) logic to a single wheel. Reduces motor torque if slip exceeds the TCS threshold.
Torque Calculates and distributes engine torque and power to the drivetrain and wheels. Handles forced induction, NOS, clutch, differentials, and applies TCS.
TryGetEditModeRigidbody Gets the runtime rigidbody without resetting its current physics state.
TryRestart Attempts to validate the vehicle and its manager before restarting. Checks for internal errors, setup completion, and manager availability.
Update Unity's Update method. Handles per-frame updates for the vehicle, including input processing, engine state, gearbox logic, lighting, and vehicle reset logic.
UpdateAI(MVC.AI.VehicleAIBehaviour.UpdateType) Updates the AI behaviour for this vehicle for the given update type. Handles activation/deactivation of AI behaviours and updates input states.
UpdateEngine Updates all engine-related systems for this physics tick. Handles boost (NOS/turbo/supercharger), torque calculation, chassis torque, and fuel consumption.
UpdateRootTransformEditMode Keeps the rigidbody frozen while runtime root transform edit mode is active.
VehicleReset Handles vehicle reset logic, including mesh visibility toggling, collision ignoring, and automatic upright reset if the vehicle is flipped.
WaitForShiftDown Coroutine to enforce a cooldown period after a downshift, preventing rapid downshifting.
WeightDistribution Recalculates and applies the vehicle's center of mass (weight distribution) if needed. Takes into account turbo/supercharger effects and current settings.
ABS
Applies anti-lock braking system (ABS) logic to all wheels. Prevents wheel lockup by modulating brake torque based on slip.
ABS(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel)
Applies ABS logic to a single wheel. Modulates brake torque if slip exceeds the ABS threshold.
Parameter Type Description
MVC.Core.VehicleWheel The wheel to apply ABS to.
AddFuel(System.Single)
Adds fuel to the current tank level and clamps the result to the configured tank capacity.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Fuel quantity to add. Negative values remove fuel, while values beyond either bound are clamped to the range from zero through .
AddNOS(System.Single)
Adds to the vehicle's total nitrous oxide supply and clamps it to the installed capacity.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Nitrous quantity to add. Negative values consume supply; the result is clamped between zero and the product of the configured bottle capacity and bottle count.
Aerodynamics
Applies aerodynamic effects to the vehicle, including drag and downforce. Drag is proportional to speed; downforce is applied at front and rear axles.
AntiSwayBars
Simulates anti-sway (anti-roll) bars to reduce body roll during cornering. Applies forces to the chassis based on wheel travel differences and slip.
ApplyCounterSteerHelper(System.Single@)
Applies the counter-steer helper to the given steer angle, using the vehicle's full steer envelope.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single@ Reference to the steer angle to modify.
ApplyCounterSteerHelper(System.Single@, System.Single)
Applies the counter-steer helper to the given steer angle, modifying it based on vehicle and settings state.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single@ Reference to the steer angle to modify.
System.Single The steer envelope the counter-steer term is scaled against. Dynamically steered wheels pass their reduced envelope so the helper cannot push them past the angle they are configured for.
ArcadeSteerHelpers
Applies arcade-style steering helpers to assist with vehicle control. Modifies angular and linear velocity to help the vehicle turn more responsively.
AspirationBoost
Handles boost from turbochargers and superchargers. Calculates engine boost value based on aspiration type, RPM, and settings.
AutoGearboxShiftUpDown(System.Single)
Handles automatic up/down gear shifting based on speed and engine RPM.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Current average speed in km/h.
AverageAngularVelocity(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[])
Averages the angular velocity of a group of wheels, in radians per second, sampled from the physics engine rather than from the wheels' own cache, which this method runs too early in the frame to see updated.
Parameter Type Description
MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[] The wheels to average.
AverageInertia(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[])
Averages the rotational inertia of a group of wheels, in kg·m².
Parameter Type Description
MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule[] The wheels to average.
Awake
Unity's lifecycle method override. Ensures the vehicle is initialized and restarted when the component is first loaded.
AxleDriveRatio(System.Boolean)
Calculates the total reduction ratio between the engine-side differential frame and the wheels of an axle, combining the selected gearbox ratio (which already includes the final drive) with the differential gear ratios along the path.
Returns The total reduction ratio. Never zero, as it is used to reflect inertias.
Parameter Type Description
System.Boolean Whether the front axle's ratio is requested.
BoostNOS
Handles the nitrous oxide (NOS) boost system, including activation, consumption, and regeneration. Also manages visual effects and progressive boost if enabled.
Brakes
Applies brake torque to all wheels based on input and drivetrain configuration. Handles both front and rear brakes, as well as handbrake and special cases for trailers.
Burnouts
Calculates burnout intensity based on drivetrain, TCS, transmission, and input conditions. Burnout intensity is used to modulate engine and handling behavior.
ChangeGear(System.Int32, System.Boolean)
Coroutine to handle the gear change process, including delays, sound effects, and state updates.
Parameter Type Description
System.Int32 Target gear index.
System.Boolean If true, shift immediately without delay.
ChassisTorque
Applies engine torque effect to the chassis for realism (e.g., torque twist). Only applies if enabled and not for certain engine/drivetrain layouts.
CounterSteer
Applies counter-steer assistance to help stabilize the vehicle during oversteer. Adjusts the counterSteerHelper value based on rear wheel slip and settings.
DetectFollowerImpactShaking
Detects impact camera shake by comparing current target rigidbody velocity against a short rolling sample window.
Donuts
Simulates "donut" maneuvers (spinning the car in place) by applying torque and force at calculated positions. Only applies if the vehicle is RWD/AWD, not stationary, and handling rate is appropriate.
Drift
Simulates drifting by applying lateral and longitudinal forces based on rear wheel slip. Only applies if the vehicle is RWD/AWD, not stationary, and handling rate is less than 1.
ESP
Applies electronic stability program (ESP) logic to help prevent skidding and loss of control. Modulates brake torque on individual wheels based on vehicle yaw angle and speed.
EnterRootTransformEditMode
Suspends root transform simulation so the vehicle can be repositioned manually at runtime.
ExitRootTransformEditMode
Restores physics simulation after runtime root transform editing.
FixedUpdate
Unity's FixedUpdate method for physics-based updates. Handles all per-physics-tick vehicle simulation, including input processing, engine, handling, and stability systems.
Fuel
Calculates and applies fuel consumption for the current physics tick. Handles both combustion and electric vehicles, including regenerative braking.
GearBox
Handles all gearbox logic, including automatic, semi-automatic, and manual shifting, as well as AI and input-based gear requests.
GearShiftSpeed(System.Int32)
Calculates the speed threshold for shifting gears.
Returns Speed threshold for the given gear.
Parameter Type Description
System.Int32 Gear index.
GearShiftUpEffects
Plays sound and visual effects for an upshift, such as turbo/supercharger blowout and exhaust flames. Chargers only blow off once they are spooled up, while exhaust flames are exclusive to redline shifts.

Coroutine to handle NOS activation delay (if enabled). Plays NOS start sound and waits for the configured delay before activating NOS.

Aspiration
Defines the engine's air intake system that affects power delivery and sound. The aspiration method significantly impacts torque curve, power delivery, throttle response, and engine sound. Used to configure engine performance characteristics and audio behavior.
Fields
Name Description
Mix Combination of multiple aspiration methods, typically turbocharger and supercharger. Features benefits of both systems with complex power delivery characteristics. Provides optimal power across the entire RPM range with sophisticated sound profile.
Natural Naturally aspirated engine without forced induction. Features linear power delivery, immediate throttle response, and distinctive sound profile. Power is limited by atmospheric pressure but provides consistent and predictable performance.
Supercharger Supercharger system that uses engine power to compress intake air. Features immediate power boost, linear power delivery, and distinctive whining sound. Provides consistent power increase across the RPM range at the cost of some engine efficiency.
Turbocharger Turbocharger system that uses exhaust gases to compress intake air. Features increased power at higher RPMs, potential turbo lag, and characteristic whistling sound. Provides significant power boost with some delay in power delivery at lower RPMs.
AudioMixersModule
Manages audio mixer groups and volume settings for various vehicle sound components.
Fields
Name Description
brakeEffects Custom audio mixer group for brake effect sounds. If null, falls back to default.
brakeEffectsVolume Volume multiplier for brake effect sounds. Default is 1.
chargersEffects Custom audio mixer group for charger effect sounds. If null, falls back to default.
chargersEffectsVolume Volume multiplier for charger effect sounds. Default is 1.
engine Custom audio mixer group for engine sounds. If null, falls back to default.
engineVolume Volume multiplier for engine sounds. Default is 1.
exhaust Custom audio mixer group for exhaust sounds. If null, falls back to default.
exhaustEffects Custom audio mixer group for exhaust effect sounds. If null, falls back to default.
exhaustEffectsVolume Volume multiplier for exhaust effect sounds. Default is 1.
exhaustVolume Volume multiplier for exhaust sounds. Default is 1.
interiorLowPassFreq Low-pass filter frequency for interior sounds. Default is 5000Hz.
supercharger Custom audio mixer group for supercharger sounds. If null, falls back to default.
superchargerVolume Volume multiplier for supercharger sounds. Default is 1.
transmission Custom audio mixer group for transmission sounds. If null, falls back to default.
transmissionVolume Volume multiplier for transmission sounds. Default is 1.
turbocharger Custom audio mixer group for turbocharger sounds. If null, falls back to default.
turbochargerVolume Volume multiplier for turbocharger sounds. Default is 1.
vehicle The vehicle this audio mixer module belongs to.

BehaviourModule
Represents the behavior module of a vehicle, managing engine characteristics, power delivery, fuel consumption, forced induction systems, and various vehicle performance parameters. This module serves as the core component for defining how a vehicle behaves in terms of power output, torque curves, fuel efficiency, and special features like NOS and regenerative braking.
Fields
Name Description
aspiration The aspiration type of the engine (Natural, Turbocharger, Supercharger, or Mix).
autoCurves Flag indicating whether power and torque curves should be automatically generated.
carClass The class of car (e.g., Road, Sport, Racing) that affects performance characteristics and handling behavior. Only applicable when vehicleType is Car.
curbWeight The base curb weight of the vehicle in kilograms, excluding charger weight modifications.
engine Cached reference to the current engine configuration.
engineIndex The index of the currently selected engine in the engines array.
engineName The name of the currently selected engine for synchronization purposes.
exhaustFlameEmissionProbability Probability of exhaust flame emission (0.0 to 1.0).
frontBrakes Front brake module configuration.
frontRearOutputFactor [Obsolete] Use Transmission.CenterDifferential.BiasAB instead. This field is deprecated and should not be used.
fuelCapacity Fuel tank capacity in liters.
fuelConsumptionCity Fuel consumption rate in city driving conditions (liters per 100 km).
fuelConsumptionCombined Combined fuel consumption rate (liters per 100 km).
fuelConsumptionHighway Fuel consumption rate in highway driving conditions (liters per 100 km).
fuelConsumptionIdleDuration Time in seconds a full tank/battery lasts while idling in time-based mode.
fuelConsumptionPrecision The precision mode for fuel consumption calculations. Advanced mode uses separate city and highway consumption values, while Simple mode uses a single combined consumption value.
fuelConsumptionThrottleDuration Time in seconds a full tank/battery lasts at full throttle in time-based mode.
fuelRegenerationBrakeDuration Time in seconds an empty battery takes to recharge under full braking in time-based mode.

isSupercharged Flag indicating whether the engine is currently supercharged.
isTurbocharged Flag indicating whether the engine is currently turbocharged.

overridePeakPowerRPM Flag indicating whether to override the engine's default peak power RPM.
overridePeakTorqueRPM Flag indicating whether to override the engine's default peak torque RPM.
peakPowerRPM Custom peak power RPM value when overriding the engine's default.
peakTorqueRPM Custom peak torque RPM value when overriding the engine's default.
powerCurve Animation curve defining how engine power varies with RPM.
powerOffset Power offset in horsepower added to the base engine power.
powerTorqueOutputScale [Obsolete] Use TorqueOutputScale instead. This field is deprecated and should not be used.

topSpeed Theoretical top speed of the vehicle in km/h for automatic gear ratio calculation.
torqueCurve Animation curve defining how engine torque varies with RPM.

torqueOutputScale Scaling factor for the final torque output.
turbocharger Cached reference to the current turbocharger configuration.
turbochargerIndex The index of the currently selected turbocharger in the chargers array.
turbochargerName The name of the currently selected turbocharger for synchronization purposes.
turbochargerWeight Additional weight in kilograms added by aftermarket turbochargers.
useExhaustEffects Gets or sets a value indicating whether exhaust visual and audio effects are enabled. This controls the rendering of exhaust flames, smoke, and related sound effects. Disabling this can improve performance on lower-end devices.
useNOS Gets or sets a value indicating whether the vehicle is equipped with a Nitrous Oxide System (NOS). When enabled, the vehicle can use NOS for temporary power boosts.
useRegenerativeBrakes Flag indicating whether regenerative braking is enabled.
useRevLimiter Gets or sets a value indicating whether the engine rev limiter is enabled. When enabled, the engine will prevent over-revving by cutting power at the maximum RPM. This helps protect the engine from damage due to excessive RPM.
vehicle Reference to the parent vehicle that owns this behaviour module.
vehicleType The type of vehicle (e.g., Car, Truck, Motorcycle) that determines basic vehicle characteristics and available features.

CarClass
Defines the different classes of cars with unique handling and performance characteristics. Each class has specific default settings for suspension, power delivery, and handling dynamics. Used to quickly configure vehicles with appropriate baseline characteristics.
Fields
Name Description
AmericanMuscle High-torque, typically rear-wheel drive vehicles with powerful engines. Characterized by strong low-end torque, softer suspension, and tendency toward oversteer. Examples include classic American V8 cars and modern muscle cars.
Electric Electric-powered vehicles with instant torque and unique power delivery. Features immediate torque availability, regenerative braking, and specialized drivetrain. Represents modern electric vehicles with their unique performance characteristics.
Elite Premium luxury vehicles with balanced performance and comfort-oriented tuning. Features refined handling, moderate power delivery, and sophisticated electronic aids. Examples include high-end luxury sedans and grand tourers.
F1 Formula 1 racing vehicles with extreme aerodynamics and performance. Features very stiff suspension, high-revving engines, and advanced aerodynamic downforce. Optimized for track performance with minimal comfort considerations.
Road Standard road vehicles for everyday use with balanced characteristics. Features moderate power, comfortable suspension, and predictable handling. Represents the baseline configuration for most consumer vehicles.
Super High-performance sports cars with advanced handling and aggressive power delivery. Features stiff suspension, responsive steering, and high power-to-weight ratio. Examples include exotic supercars and high-performance sports cars.
DriverIKModule
The DriverIKModule class manages the Inverse Kinematics (IK) setup for a vehicle's driver, including hand and foot pivots for animation and interaction with vehicle controls. It provides properties to access and modify IK pivots, driver assignment, and validation checks for the module's configuration.

rightFootPivot The IK pivot for the driver's right foot (e.g., pedal interaction).
rightHandSteeringWheelPivot The IK pivot for the driver's right hand on the steering wheel.
steeringWheelAngleParameter The parameter name used to control the steering wheel angle in animations.

HeavyTruckClass
Defines the different classes of heavy trucks with unique handling and performance characteristics. Each class has specific default settings for load capacity, power delivery, and handling dynamics. Used to quickly configure heavy vehicles with appropriate baseline characteristics.
Fields
Name Description
Electric Electric-powered trucks with alternative drivetrain and unique power characteristics. Features immediate torque, regenerative braking, and specialized power management. Represents modern electric commercial vehicles with their unique performance profile.
Road Standard commercial road trucks optimized for cargo transport and efficiency. Features moderate power, sturdy suspension, and stability-focused handling. Represents typical long-haul or delivery trucks used in commercial applications.
Sport Performance-oriented trucks with enhanced handling and power delivery. Features more responsive steering, firmer suspension, and higher power output. Represents specialized performance or racing trucks with improved dynamics.
InputsAccess
Manages all vehicle input handling including keyboard, gamepad, and mobile controls. Provides access to input states, processes input values, and handles haptic feedback (rumble). This struct is responsible for: - Processing raw input values from different input systems - Managing input state transitions (pressed/released) - Handling input overrides for AI or scripted control - Calculating and applying gamepad rumble effects based on vehicle state - Supporting multiple input systems (Unity Input, InputsManager, Mobile)

NOS Whether the NOS (Nitrous Oxide System) button is currently pressed

brakeSlipRightSideRumble Rumble intensity for right side during brake slip (skidding)

forwardSlipRightSideRumble Rumble intensity for right side during forward slip (wheelspin)

gamepadRightSideRumble Combined rumble intensity for right side of gamepad

m_mobileRumble Smoothed rumble value for mobile device

nosRumble Rumble intensity for NOS activation

offRoadRightSideRumble Rumble intensity for right side when vehicle is off-road
offRoadRumbleMultiplier Multiplier for off-road rumble based on vehicle speed

speedRightSideRumble Rumble intensity for right side based on vehicle speed

SFXSheet
Manages all sound effects for the vehicle, including engine, exhaust, turbocharger, supercharger, transmission, impacts, and other vehicle-related audio.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-exhaustsblowoutsourcesgroup](ExhaustsBlowoutSourcesGroup) Manages audio sources for exhaust blowout effects, including gurgle and pop sounds. This class handles the creation and organization of audio sources for different exhaust sound effects.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-gearshiftingsources](GearShiftingSources) Manages audio sources for gear shifting sounds in the vehicle. This class handles both upshift and downshift sound effects.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-impactsources](ImpactSources) Manages audio sources for different types of vehicle impact sounds.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-levelledsourcesgroup](LevelledSourcesGroup) Manages audio sources for different intensity levels of sound effects.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-nossourcesgroup](NOSSourcesGroup) Manages audio sources for NOS (Nitrous Oxide System) sound effects.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-updateenginejob](UpdateEngineJob) Burst-compiled job for efficiently updating engine and exhaust audio parameters.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-wheelgroundaudiostate](WheelGroundAudioState) Tracks smoothed slip and roll levels for one wheel while building shared ground-loop candidates.
[#mvc-core-vehicle-sfxsheet-wheelgroundloopcandidate](WheelGroundLoopCandidate) Stores the loudest loop source candidate for a ground and sound category during the current frame.

Methods
Name Description
ApplyWheelGroundCandidates(MVC.VehicleAudioSource[], MVC.Core.Vehicle.SFXSheet.WheelGroundLoopCandidate[]) Applies the selected candidates to a category of shared loop sources and pauses inactive sources.
CarImpact(System.Single, UnityEngine.Vector3) Plays an impact sound effect when the vehicle collides with another vehicle. The sound volume and characteristics are adjusted based on the collision intensity.
CelerationClipInitialize(UnityEngine.Object[]) Initializes audio clips for engine and exhaust sounds based on RPM values. Parses RPM values from clip names and sorts them in ascending order.
CelerationSourcesAccessInitialize(MVC.Base.VehicleEngine.AudioModule.CelerationSource[]) Creates native arrays for accessing audio source parameters from jobs. This allows for thread-safe audio parameter updates.
CelerationSourcesInitialize(System.Boolean, MVC.Base.VehicleEngine.AudioModule.CelerationClip[], UnityEngine.Transform, UnityEngine.Vector3, UnityEngine.Audio.AudioMixerGroup) Creates audio sources for engine or exhaust sounds with appropriate filters and settings.
ClearWheelGroundCandidates Clears all per-ground candidates before collecting this frame's wheel audio levels.
CreateWheelGroundLoopSource(UnityEngine.Transform, UnityEngine.Vector3, System.String, UnityEngine.AudioClip) Creates one non-spatialized loop source for a wheel-ground sound category.
Dispose Cleans up and disposes of all native collections used by the SFXSheet. Called when the vehicle is destroyed or disabled.
EngineStart Plays the engine starting sound effect. Used when the vehicle's engine is first started.
EnsureWheelGroundAudioStates Ensures the smoothed wheel audio state array matches the current wheel count.
ExhaustGurgle Plays an exhaust gurgle sound effect. Typically used when the engine is at low RPM or during deceleration.
ExhaustPop Plays an exhaust pop/backfire sound effect. Typically used during aggressive deceleration or when fuel cutoff occurs. Not available for diesel engines or electric vehicles.
GearboxShiftDown Plays a gear shift down sound effect for manual transmissions. Called when the driver shifts to a lower gear.
GearboxShiftUp Plays a gear shift up sound effect for manual transmissions. Called when the driver shifts to a higher gear.
GetWheelGroundAudioState(System.Int32, MVC.Core.VehicleWheel) Gets the persistent smoothing state for a wheel, resetting it when the wheel reference changes.
GetWheelGroundSkidAudioLevel(System.Single, System.Single) Maps wheel slip to a normalized skid-audio level.
GetWheelGroundSkidAudioPitch(System.Single) Converts skid intensity to the pitch used by skid loops.
IndicatorChange Plays the turn indicator sound effect. This is triggered when the driver activates or deactivates a turn signal.
InitializeWheelGroundSources(UnityEngine.Vector3) Creates the shared per-ground loop sources and candidate buffers used by wheel-ground audio.
LevelledImpact(MVC.Core.Vehicle.SFXSheet.LevelledSourcesGroup, System.Single, UnityEngine.Vector3) Plays impact sounds with different intensity levels based on relative velocity.
NOSStart Plays the Nitrous Oxide System (NOS) activation sound effect. This is triggered when the NOS system is first engaged.
PauseWheelGroundSource(MVC.VehicleAudioSource) Pauses and disables a wheel-ground loop source when it is not the active candidate.
RandomizeWheelGroundLoopStart(MVC.VehicleAudioSource) Randomizes a looping clip's initial sample to reduce obvious synchronization between ground loops.
ResetWheelGroundAudioState(System.Int32, MVC.Core.VehicleWheel) Resets the smoothing state for a wheel index and records its current wheel reference.
SmoothWheelGroundAudioLevel(System.Single, System.Single) Smooths a wheel-ground audio level using separate attack and release times.
SuperchargerFuelBlowout Plays a supercharger blowout sound when fuel input changes. This sound effect simulates the characteristic whine of a supercharger when lifting off the throttle.
SuperchargerGearBlowout Plays a supercharger blowout sound when shifting gears. This sound effect simulates the characteristic whine of a supercharger during gear changes.
SuperchargerRevBlowout Plays a supercharger blowout sound when engine RPM changes significantly. This sound effect simulates the characteristic whine of a supercharger during rapid RPM changes.
TransmissionSourcesInitialize(MVC.ToolkitSettings.TransmissionWhineClipsGroup, UnityEngine.Transform, UnityEngine.Vector3, UnityEngine.Audio.AudioMixerGroup) Creates audio sources for transmission whine sounds. These sounds represent the mechanical noise of the transmission at different speeds.
TurbochargerFuelBlowout Plays a turbocharger blowout sound when fuel input changes. This sound effect simulates the pressure release from the turbocharger when lifting off the throttle.
TurbochargerGearBlowout Plays a turbocharger blowout sound when shifting gears. This sound effect simulates the pressure release from the turbocharger during gear changes.
TurbochargerRevBlowout Plays a turbocharger blowout sound when engine RPM changes significantly. This sound effect simulates the pressure release from the turbocharger during rapid RPM changes.
Update Updates all vehicle sound effects based on the current vehicle state. Called every frame to adjust audio parameters like volume and pitch.
UpdateCeleration(MVC.Base.VehicleEngine.AudioModule.CelerationSource[], Unity.Collections.NativeArray{MVC.Base.VehicleEngine.AudioModule.CelerationSourceAccess}) Updates the audio parameters for engine or exhaust sounds based on current RPM. Handles enabling/disabling sources and adjusting volume and pitch.
UpdateEngine Updates all engine-related sound effects based on current vehicle state. Uses a job system for efficient parallel processing of audio parameters.
UpdateEngineLoopPlaybackState(System.Boolean, System.Single, System.Boolean@) Determines whether continuous engine loops should remain active while the engine is stopped but still audibly spinning down. Running engines arm the shutdown tail; stopped engines keep loops alive until RPM drops below the silent threshold.
UpdateExhaust Updates exhaust sound effects based on vehicle state and user inputs. Triggers exhaust pops and gurgles when appropriate conditions are met.
UpdateNOS Updates NOS (Nitrous Oxide System) sound effects based on vehicle state. Manages NOS audio sources when the system is active.
UpdateSupercharger Updates supercharger sound effects based on vehicle state and user inputs. Manages idle and active supercharger sounds, and triggers blowout effects when appropriate.
UpdateTransmission Updates transmission sound effects based on vehicle state. Manages reversing sounds and transmission whining based on gear, speed, and direction.
UpdateTurbocharger Updates turbocharger sound effects based on vehicle state and user inputs. Manages idle and active turbocharger sounds, and triggers blowout effects when appropriate.
UpdateWheelGroundCandidate(MVC.Core.VehicleWheel.WheelModule, System.Int32) Updates smoothed audio levels for one wheel and offers it as a per-ground loop candidate.
UpdateWheelGroundLoopingSource(MVC.VehicleAudioSource, System.Single, System.Single) Updates volume, pitch, and playback state for an active wheel-ground loop source.
UpdateWheelGroundPlaybackState(MVC.VehicleAudioSource, System.Single) Starts, resumes, or pauses a wheel-ground loop based on its target volume.
UpdateWheelGroundSources Updates shared wheel-ground loop sources once per frame using the loudest wheel candidate per ground type.
UpdateWind Updates wind sound effects based on vehicle speed. Manages the wind audio source volume and playback state.
WallImpact(System.Single, UnityEngine.Vector3) Plays an impact sound effect when the vehicle collides with a wall or static object. The sound volume and characteristics are adjusted based on the collision intensity.
op_Implicit(MVC.Core.Vehicle.SFXSheet)~System.Boolean Determines whether an SFX sheet reference points to an initialized module instance.

Determines whether continuous engine loops should remain active while the engine is stopped but still audibly spinning down. Running engines arm the shutdown tail; stopped engines keep loops alive until RPM drops below the silent threshold.

System.Single Current engine speed in revolutions per minute.

ExhaustsBlowoutSourcesGroup
Manages audio sources for exhaust blowout effects, including gurgle and pop sounds. This class handles the creation and organization of audio sources for different exhaust sound effects.
Fields
Name Description
clipsGroup Reference to the clips group containing the audio clips for exhaust effects.
gurgle Array of audio sources for exhaust gurgle effects. These represent the softer, bubbling sounds that occur at medium RPM.
pop Array of audio sources for exhaust pop effects. These represent the louder, sharper sounds that occur at high RPM.

StabilityAccess
A read-only structure that provides efficient access to stability settings. This struct is optimized for marshaling between managed and unmanaged code, allowing stability settings to be efficiently passed to native code components. It serves as an immutable snapshot of a StabilityModule's current state.
Fields
Name Description
ABSThreshold The slip threshold at which ABS activates. Lower values make ABS more sensitive (activates earlier).
ESPAllowDonuts When enabled, allows the vehicle to perform donuts by setting a higher ESP speed threshold. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
ESPSpeedThreshold The minimum speed threshold at which ESP becomes active. ESP will not intervene below this speed.
ESPStrength Controls the intensity of ESP intervention. Higher values result in stronger stability control.
TCSAllowBurnouts When enabled, allows the vehicle to perform burnouts by temporarily disabling TCS. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
TCSThreshold The slip threshold at which TCS activates. Lower values make TCS more sensitive (activates earlier).
angularDrag Controls the angular drag coefficient of the vehicle. Higher values cause the vehicle to resist rotation more strongly.
antiSwayFront The stiffness value for the front anti-sway bar. Higher values reduce body roll but may reduce grip in some situations.
antiSwayRear The stiffness value for the rear anti-sway bar. Higher values reduce body roll but may reduce grip in some situations.
drag Controls the linear drag coefficient of the vehicle. Higher values cause the vehicle to slow down more quickly when coasting.
dragScale A multiplier for all drag forces applied to the vehicle. Range: 0-2, where 0 is no drag, 1 is normal drag, and 2 is double drag.
frontDownforce Controls the amount of downforce applied to the front of the vehicle. Higher values increase front grip at high speeds.
handlingRate Controls the overall handling responsiveness of the vehicle. Higher values make the vehicle more responsive but potentially less stable.
rearDownforce Controls the amount of downforce applied to the rear of the vehicle. Higher values increase rear grip at high speeds.
steerHelperAngularVelocityStrength Controls the intensity of the angular steering helper. This helper applies corrective forces based on the vehicle's angular velocity.
steerHelperLinearVelocityStrength Controls the intensity of the linear steering helper. This helper applies corrective forces based on the vehicle's linear velocity.
useABS Indicates whether the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) is enabled. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useAntiSwayBars Indicates whether anti-sway bars are enabled. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useCounterSteer Determines whether counter-steering assistance is enabled. Counter-steering helps recover from slides by automatically applying opposite steering. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useDownforce Determines whether aerodynamic downforce is applied to the vehicle. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useESP Indicates whether Electronic Stability Program (ESP) is enabled. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useHandbrakeABS Indicates whether ABS also applies to handbrake input. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useLaunchControl Determines whether launch control is enabled. Launch control optimizes acceleration from a standing start. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useParkingBrake Indicates whether the handbrake is applied automatically while the engine is off. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useSteeringHelper Indicates whether arcade-style steering helpers are enabled. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
useTCS Indicates whether Traction Control System (TCS) is enabled. Marshaled as a boolean (U1) for efficient interop.
weightDistribution Controls the front-to-rear weight distribution of the vehicle. Range: 0-1, where 0 is all weight on front wheels and 1 is all weight on rear wheels.
weightHeight Controls the height of the vehicle's center of mass. Range: 0-1, where 0 is lowest and 1 is highest.

StabilityModule
The StabilityModule class manages all vehicle stability control systems and physics properties. This includes anti-sway bars, ABS, ESP, TCS, steering helpers, weight distribution, downforce, and drag properties. It provides a comprehensive set of parameters to fine-tune vehicle handling characteristics.
Fields
Name Description
ESPAllowDonuts When enabled, allows the vehicle to perform donuts by setting a higher ESP speed threshold. This prevents ESP from intervening during controlled circular drifts.
TCSAllowBurnouts When enabled, allows the vehicle to perform burnouts by temporarily disabling TCS. This permits wheel spin during standing starts for drag racing or showing off.
angularDrag Angular drag coefficient. Default is 0.25.
antiSwayFront Front anti-sway bar stiffness value. Default is 10000.
antiSwayRear Rear anti-sway bar stiffness value. Default is 10000.
arcadeAngularSteerHelperIntensity Angular steering helper intensity. Default is 0.0 (disabled).
arcadeLinearSteerHelperIntensity Linear steering helper intensity. Default is 1.0.
drag Linear drag coefficient. Default is 0.05.
dragCoefficient Forward drag coefficient. Default is 0.3.
dragScale Overall drag force multiplier. Default is 1.0.
frontDownforce Front downforce value. Default is 50.
frontLateralDragCoefficient Front lateral drag coefficient. Default is 0.25.
frontalArea Frontal area for drag calculations. Default is 1.0.
handlingRate Overall handling responsiveness. Default is 1.0 (maximum responsiveness).
m_ABSThreshold ABS activation threshold. Default is 0.1 (activates at 10% slip).
m_ESPSpeedThreshold Minimum speed for ESP activation. Default is 10 units.
m_ESPStrength ESP intervention strength. Default is 1.0 (maximum intervention).
m_TCSThreshold TCS activation threshold. Default is 0.25 (activates at 25% slip).
rearDownforce Rear downforce value. Default is 50.
rearLateralDragCoefficient Rear lateral drag coefficient. Default is 0.25.
useABS Determines whether the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) is enabled. ABS prevents wheels from locking up during heavy braking, maintaining steering control.
useAntiSwayBars Determines whether anti-sway bars are enabled for the vehicle. Anti-sway bars reduce body roll during cornering by connecting opposite wheels together.
useArcadeSteerHelpers Determines whether arcade-style steering helpers are enabled. These helpers make the vehicle more responsive and easier to control.
useCounterSteer Whether counter-steering assistance is enabled. Default is true.
useDownforce Determines whether aerodynamic downforce is applied to the vehicle. Downforce increases grip at higher speeds by pushing the vehicle down.
useESP Determines whether Electronic Stability Program (ESP) is enabled. ESP helps maintain directional control during cornering by applying individual wheel brakes.
useHandbrakeABS Determines whether ABS is active during handbrake application. When enabled, provides some ABS functionality even when using the handbrake.
useParkingBrake Determines whether the parking brake is engaged automatically while the engine is off, or while the vehicle is fully idle (in neutral, at idle RPM and not moving). Holds the vehicle in place by applying handbrake torque to the rear wheels.
useSteeringHelper Obsolete property. Use useArcadeSteerHelpers instead.
useTCS Determines whether Traction Control System (TCS) is enabled. TCS prevents wheel spin during acceleration by reducing engine power.
vehicle Reference to the parent vehicle.
verticalDragCoefficient Vertical drag coefficient. Default is 0.5.
weightDistribution Front-to-rear weight distribution. Default is 0.5 (50/50 distribution).
weightHeight Height of center of mass. Default is -1 (needs to be refreshed). A negative value indicates that the weight height needs to be calculated.
Methods
Name Description
TryRefreshWeightHeight(MVC.Core.Vehicle.StabilityModule) Attempts to refresh the weight height of the stability module if needed. If the vehicle reference is invalid or the weight height is already set (>= 0), this method does nothing. Otherwise, it calls the vehicle's RefreshWeightHeight method.
op_Implicit(MVC.Core.Vehicle.StabilityModule)~System.Boolean Implicit conversion to boolean that checks if the module instance is not null. Allows using the module directly in conditional statements.

Attempts to refresh the weight height of the stability module if needed. If the vehicle reference is invalid or the weight height is already set (>= 0), this method does nothing. Otherwise, it calls the vehicle's RefreshWeightHeight method.

StatsAccess
StatsAccess provides a comprehensive data structure for tracking and calculating various vehicle statistics. It stores information about wheel positions, velocities, friction values, ground contact data, and other vehicle performance metrics. This struct is designed to be used with Unity's Job System for efficient parallel processing of vehicle physics calculations.

velocity The linear velocity of the vehicle in world space.
visualSteerAngle The steering angle in degrees used to drive steering visuals such as the interior steering wheel. This is renormalized to full-lock units so a full input reads as full lock regardless of the speed-based reduction applied by the steering method, with the counter-steer helper included. Not clamped to the vehicle's maximum steer angle: the renormalization scales the counter-steer term up as speed reduces , so this may exceed it during a counter-steer save.
wheelPower The total power being delivered to the wheels in horsepower
wheelTorque The total torque being applied to the wheels

Defines the different steering calculation methods available for the vehicle.
Fields
Name Description
Ackermann Ackermann steering method that calculates proper steering angles for each wheel to prevent tire scrubbing during turns.
Responsive Responsive steering method that provides more dynamic steering behavior.
Simple Simple steering method that applies uniform steering angle to all wheels.
Train
Defines the drivetrain configuration that determines which wheels receive power. This configuration significantly affects vehicle handling, traction, and performance characteristics. Used throughout the physics simulation to determine power distribution and traction modeling.
Fields
Name Description
AWD All-Wheel Drive - power delivered to all wheels. Provides optimal traction in all conditions with more complex power distribution. Common in SUVs, performance vehicles, and vehicles designed for all-weather capability.
FWD Front-Wheel Drive - power delivered to front wheels only. Typically provides better traction on slippery surfaces but tends toward understeer. Common in economy cars and many modern passenger vehicles.
None No driven wheels (rare/special case). Used for special vehicles or simulation scenarios where no wheels are powered. Examples include gravity-powered vehicles or purely theoretical configurations.
RWD Rear-Wheel Drive - power delivered to rear wheels only. Provides better weight distribution and performance handling but less traction in poor conditions. Common in sports cars, performance vehicles, and traditional luxury cars.
TransmissionAccess
Provides read-only access to transmission module data for efficient vehicle simulation. This struct encapsulates all transmission-related properties and arrays needed for vehicle physics calculations, gear shifting, and performance optimization. Implements IDisposable to properly manage native array memory allocation.
Fields
Name Description
autoGearRatios Indicates whether gear ratios are automatically calculated based on speed targets. When true, the system automatically optimizes gear ratios for performance.
centerDifferentialAccess Access object for the center differential configuration. Contains differential settings specific to AWD vehicles.
clipsGroupIndex Index of the audio clips group for transmission whine sounds. Used to select appropriate audio feedback based on transmission configuration.
clutchInDelay Time delay in seconds for clutch engagement during gear shifts. Simulates realistic clutch behavior and prevents instant gear changes.
clutchOutDelay Time delay in seconds for clutch disengagement during gear shifts. Works with clutchInDelay to create realistic gear shifting mechanics.
efficiency Current efficiency of the transmission system (0.0 to 1.0). Represents how effectively the transmission transfers power from engine to wheels.
finalGearRatio Final drive ratio applied to all gear ratios. Multiplies all gear ratios to achieve the final mechanical advantage.
frontDifferentialAccess Access object for the front differential configuration. Contains differential settings for front-wheel drive and AWD vehicles.
gearRatios Native array containing gear ratios for the primary gearbox. Defines the mechanical advantage for each forward gear.
gearRatios2 Native array containing gear ratios for the secondary gearbox (double gearbox systems). Used in AWD vehicles to provide different ratios for front and rear axles.
gearShiftTorque Torque threshold in Newton-meters below which the gearbox is forced to shift. Equals gearShiftTorqueMultiplier scaled by the vehicle's torque.
gearShiftTorqueMultiplier Fraction of the vehicle's torque available during gear shifts (0.0 to 1.0).
gearShiftUpOverrideSpeeds Native array containing override speeds for gear shifting up in km/h. Allows custom gear shift points that override automatic calculations.
gearbox The type of gearbox system (Manual or Automatic). Determines how gear shifting is handled in the vehicle simulation.
gearsCount Total number of forward gears in the transmission. Determines the size of gear-related arrays and available gear range.
maximumTorque Maximum torque capacity of the transmission system in Newton-meters. Used for efficiency calculations and transmission stress simulation.
minSpeedTargets Native array containing minimum speeds required for each gear in km/h. Prevents downshifting to gears that would cause engine stalling.
overrideGearShiftUpSpeeds Native array indicating which gears have override speeds enabled. Controls whether custom shift speeds are used for each gear.
playClipsGroupStartingFromGear The gear number from which transmission whine audio clips should start playing. Allows fine-tuning of audio feedback timing during gear changes.
rearDifferentialAccess Access object for the rear differential configuration. Contains differential settings for rear-wheel drive and AWD vehicles.
reverseGearRatio Gear ratio for reverse gear in the primary gearbox. Determines the mechanical advantage for reverse motion.
reverseGearRatio2 Gear ratio for reverse gear in the secondary gearbox (for double gearbox systems). Used in AWD vehicles with separate front/rear gear ratios.
reverseMinSpeedTarget Minimum speed in km/h required for reverse gear engagement. Prevents reverse gear from being engaged at inappropriate speeds.
reverseSpeedTarget Target speed in km/h for reverse gear operation. Used for reverse gear ratio calculations and performance optimization.
shiftDelay Total time delay in seconds for complete gear shifting operation. Includes both clutch and mechanical shifting time for realistic simulation.
speedTargets Native array containing target speeds for each forward gear in km/h. Used for automatic gear shifting decisions and performance calculations.
useDoubleGearbox Indicates whether the vehicle uses a double gearbox system. Used primarily for AWD vehicles to provide separate gear ratios for front and rear axles.

TransmissionModule
Manages the transmission system of a vehicle, including gear ratios, shifting behavior, and differential configurations. This module handles both manual and automatic transmissions, supports single and double gearbox systems for AWD vehicles, and provides comprehensive gear management with automatic ratio calculation capabilities.

VFXSheet
Manages all visual effects for the vehicle including exhaust effects, collision sparks, and NOS flames. This class handles particle system creation, management, and real-time updates for various VFX elements.
Fields
Name Description
NOSFlameColor Base color for NOS flame effects. Used for enhanced flame effects when nitrous oxide is activated.
NOSFlameEmissionScales Original emission curves for NOS flame particle systems and their children. Stored to allow distance-based VFX culling to fade flame intensity.
NOSFlames Array of NOS (Nitrous Oxide System) flame particle systems. Creates enhanced flame effects when NOS is activated.
collisionSparks Dictionary mapping collision transforms to their associated spark particle systems. Used to track and manage collision spark effects for different objects.
exhaustFlameColor Base color for exhaust flame effects. Extracted from the exhaust flame particle system material for consistent coloring.
exhaustFlameEmissionScales Original emission curves for exhaust flame particle systems and their children. Stored to allow distance-based VFX culling to fade flame intensity.
exhaustFlames Array of exhaust flame particle systems for gasoline engines. Creates visual flame effects when the engine is running.
exhaustLights Array of light components used for exhaust flame lighting. Provides dynamic lighting that changes color and intensity based on flame activity.
exhaustSmokeEmissionScales Original emission curves for exhaust smoke particle systems and their children. Stored to allow dynamic adjustment of smoke intensity based on engine load.
exhaustSmokes Array of exhaust smoke particle systems for diesel engines. Each exhaust pipe gets its own smoke particle system.
flameLights List of lists containing indices of exhaust flames that share the same light source. Groups nearby exhausts to share lighting effects for better performance and visual consistency.
vehicle Reference to the parent vehicle instance. Used to access vehicle properties and methods for VFX management.
Methods
Name Description
CreateCollisionSpark(UnityEngine.Collision) Creates collision spark effects at the collision point. Processes collision contact points using a burst job and spawns spark particle systems. Skips spark creation for dynamic non-kinematic rigidbodies.
DestroyCollisionSpark(UnityEngine.Transform) Destroys collision spark effects for a specific transform. Removes the spark particle system and cleans up the dictionary entry.
EmitNOSFlames(System.Boolean) Controls the emission of NOS (Nitrous Oxide System) flame effects. Starts or stops NOS flame particle systems based on the emit parameter and vehicle state.
SetExhaustLightsColor(UnityEngine.Color) Applies a color to every exhaust flame light.

VehicleType
Defines the main categories of vehicles supported by the controller. This enum is used throughout the system to determine appropriate physics models, handling characteristics, and available configuration options.
Fields
Name Description
Car Standard passenger vehicle with typical consumer car characteristics. Includes sedans, coupes, hatchbacks, SUVs, and other personal vehicles.
HeavyTruck Large commercial or industrial vehicle with specialized handling and physics. Includes semi-trucks, box trucks, construction vehicles, and other large transport vehicles. These vehicles typically have higher mass, different center of gravity, and specialized drivetrains.
VehicleCamera
Represents a camera configuration for a vehicle, supporting both follower and pivot camera types. Provides extensive customization for camera features, orbiting, field of view, shaking, and impact response. This class is serializable and can be used as a component in Unity's toolkit system.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-cameratype](CameraType) Specifies the type of camera configuration.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-followerfeature](FollowerFeature) Flags for features available to Follower cameras. Multiple features can be combined using bitwise operations.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-impactaxis](ImpactAxis) Flags for axes along which the camera can respond to impacts. Multiple axes can be combined using bitwise operations.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-pivotfeature](PivotFeature) Flags for features available to Pivot cameras. Multiple features can be combined using bitwise operations.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-pivotpositiontype](PivotPositionType) Specifies the pivot position for Pivot cameras.
[#mvc-core-vehiclecamera-shakingtype](ShakingType) Specifies the type of shaking effect for the camera.
