CameraType
Specifies the type of camera configuration.
Fields
Name Description
Follower Follower camera: Follows the vehicle from behind or a set offset, maintaining a fixed relationship to the vehicle's movement.
Pivot Pivot camera: Rotates around a pivot point, typically allowing the user to orbit around the vehicle or a specific point of interest.
FollowerFeature
Flags for features available to Follower cameras. Multiple features can be combined using bitwise operations.
Fields
Name Description
BrakeSlipShaking Adds a shaking effect when braking causes slip.
ForwardSlipShaking Adds a shaking effect based on forward slip (wheel spin or loss of traction).
GearPulse Adds a pulsing effect to the camera based on gear changes.
HorizontalOrbit Allows the camera to orbit horizontally around the vehicle.
NOSFieldOfView Increases the camera's field of view when NOS (nitrous oxide) is active.
NOSShaking Adds a shaking effect when NOS is active.
None No features enabled.
ObstaclesDetection Enables detection and response to obstacles in the camera's path.
OffRoadShaking Adds a shaking effect when the vehicle is off-road.
Showcase Enables showcase mode, typically for cinematic or presentation purposes.
SidewaysSlipPulse Adds a pulsing effect to the camera based on sideways slip (drifting).
SidewaysSlipShaking Adds a shaking effect based on sideways slip (drifting).
SpeedPulse Adds a pulsing effect to the camera based on the vehicle's speed.
SpeedShaking Adds a shaking effect to the camera based on vehicle speed.
SteeringTilt Tilts the camera in response to steering input.
StuntsShowcase Enables stunts showcase mode, highlighting stunts or tricks performed by the vehicle.
VerticalOrbit Allows the camera to orbit vertically around the vehicle.
ImpactAxis
Flags for axes along which the camera can respond to impacts. Multiple axes can be combined using bitwise operations.
Fields
Name Description
HorizontalX Respond to impacts along the horizontal (X) axis.
None No impact response on any axis.
VerticalY Respond to impacts along the vertical (Y) axis.
PivotFeature
Flags for features available to Pivot cameras. Multiple features can be combined using bitwise operations.
Fields
Name Description
HorizontalOrbit Allows the camera to orbit horizontally around the pivot point.
NOSFieldOfView Increases the camera's field of view when NOS (nitrous oxide) is active.
NOSShaking Adds a shaking effect when NOS is active.
None No features enabled.
ObstaclesDetection Enables detection and response to obstacles in the camera's path.
OffRoadShaking Adds a shaking effect when the vehicle is off-road.
SpeedFieldOfView Adjusts the camera's field of view based on vehicle speed.
SpeedShaking Adds a shaking effect to the camera based on vehicle speed.
SteeringSidePulse Adds a pulsing effect to the camera based on steering input (side-to-side).
SteeringTilt Tilts the camera in response to steering input.
VerticalOrbit Allows the camera to orbit vertically around the pivot point.
PivotPositionType
Specifies the pivot position for Pivot cameras.
Fields
Name Description
Inside The pivot point is inside the vehicle, typically used for first-person or cockpit views.
Outside The pivot point is outside the vehicle, typically used for third-person or chase views.
ShakingType
Specifies the type of shaking effect for the camera.
Fields
Name Description
Intense Intense shaking: Stronger, more pronounced camera shake, typically used for dramatic effects.
Normal Normal shaking: Standard camera shake effect, suitable for most situations.

Name Description

Methods
Name Description
Exhausts Updates the exhaust model's position to simulate engine vibration or shake. The shake is based on engine power and random noise for realism.
FixedUpdate Unity FixedUpdate method. Handles physics updates for wings. Only applies if the chassis is awakened and not a trailer.
IgnoreCollider(UnityEngine.Collider, System.Boolean) Ignores or restores collision between a specific collider and the chassis ground mappers.
IgnoreColliders(System.Boolean) Ignores or restores collision between the chassis and its ignored colliders. This is useful for preventing self-collision or for special simulation cases.
Initialize Initializes or resets the chassis state, restoring wings and exhausts to their original positions. This is called during restart and ensures the chassis is in a clean state.
LateUpdate Unity LateUpdate method. Handles per-frame updates for vehicle lights.
Lights Updates all lights attached to the vehicle instance. Skips update if there are internal errors or lights are disabled in settings.
OnDrawGizmosSelected Draws gizmos in the Unity editor to visualize the engine position when the chassis is selected. Only draws if the chassis is not a trailer and is properly set up.
RecalculateEnginePosition Recalculates the engine center position based on the chassis bounds and engine position setting. This is used for accurate force application and visualization.
RefreshFollowerPivots Refreshes the follower pivots for the chassis, ensuring all components are parented correctly. This is used for camera and follower logic.
Restart Restarts and reinitializes the chassis, resetting all relevant state and preparing the chassis for operation. This includes setting up wings, exhausts, and colliders, and ensuring the chassis is ready for simulation.
Update Unity Update method. Handles per-frame updates for wings and exhausts. Skips update if not awakened or if this is a trailer.
WingForces Applies aerodynamic forces (downforce and drag) from wings to the vehicle's rigidbody. Only applies if enabled in settings and wings are present.
Wings Updates the position and rotation of all dynamic wings on the chassis. Handles both logarithmic and linear interpolation for smooth movement.

VehicleDifferential
Partial class containing temporary variables for the VehicleDifferential system. This class holds runtime state variables that are updated during differential calculations and represent the current state of the differential outputs.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehicledifferential-differentialtype](DifferentialType) Defines the type of differential behavior for torque distribution between left and right wheels.
[#mvc-core-vehicledifferential-splittorque](SplitTorque) Delegate for splitting input torque between two outputs based on their angular velocities, inertias, and other parameters. Used to implement different types of differential behaviors (open, locked, limited slip, custom). This delegate signature allows for completely custom torque distribution logic while maintaining consistency with the built-in differential types.
Fields
Name Description
LOCK_DEADBAND Width of the band, in rad/s on the differential's input shaft, over which the lock fades in. Speed differences well inside this band produce almost no locking torque. Sized to sit above the residual churn a parked car settles into, and far below any real wheel slip: geared down to a driven wheel this is under a rev per second, while genuine slip during wheelspin or cornering runs two to three orders of magnitude higher.
LOCK_ENGAGE_SPEED Shaft speed, in rad/s on the input shaft, above which the lock is considered fully engaged by rotation alone.
LOCK_ENGAGE_TORQUE Input torque, in N·m, above which the lock is considered fully engaged by drive alone.
LOCK_RELAXATION Fraction of the full equalizing torque the lock is allowed to apply in one step. Anything at or above 1 is a deadbeat correction, which rings when driven by a measurement that is a step old.
MIN_COASTING_ANGULAR_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD Angular velocity threshold, in rad/s, above which the differential is considered to be coasting.
biasAB Torque bias between left (A) and right (B) outputs. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
coastRamp Coast ramp stiffness for limited slip differential. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
gearRatio Output gear ratio multiplier. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
outputAngularVelocityA Angular velocity of the left output (A). Measured in Radians per Second (rad/s). This value represents the current rotational speed of the left wheel or output. Updated during differential calculations to reflect the current state.
outputAngularVelocityB Angular velocity of the right output (B). Measured in Radians per Second (rad/s). This value represents the current rotational speed of the right wheel or output. Updated during differential calculations to reflect the current state.
outputInertiaA The current inertia of the left output (A). Measured in kg·m². This value is calculated and updated during differential operations.
outputInertiaB The current inertia of the right output (B). Measured in kg·m². This value is calculated and updated during differential operations.
outputTorqueA The current torque being delivered to the left output (A). Measured in Newton·Meters (N·m). This value is calculated and updated during differential operations.
outputTorqueB The current torque being delivered to the right output (B). Measured in Newton·Meters (N·m). This value is calculated and updated during differential operations.
powerRamp Power ramp stiffness for limited slip differential. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
slipTorque Maximum clutch pack holding torque for the limited slip differential. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
splitTorqueDelegate Custom torque distribution delegate for custom differential types. Assigned at runtime; delegates cannot be serialized by Unity, so it is rebuilt from on initialization.
stiffness Stiffness of the locking differential. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
type The type of differential behavior. Serialized for Unity inspector editing.
Methods
Name Description
EqualizingTorque(System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single) Calculates the torque that has to be transferred from the faster output to the slower one in order to bring both outputs to a common angular velocity.
Initialize Initializes the differential, setting up the torque split delegate and resetting all output values. Should be called before simulation steps.
LSDTorqueSplit(System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single@, System.Single@) Calculates torque split for a Limited Slip Differential (LSD). The differential first splits the input torque according to , then transfers torque from the faster output to the slower one through a clutch pack. The pack's holding capacity is the active ramp applied to the input torque, plus a static part set by , capped by the maximum slip torque. A limited slip differential provides controlled resistance to wheel speed differences, balancing traction and steering ability better than a locked differential.
LockEngagement(System.Single, System.Single, System.Single) How engaged the lock is, in the range [0, 1], given how fast the outputs are turning and how hard the differential is being driven.
LockingTorqueSplit(System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single@, System.Single@) Calculates torque split for a locked (or locking) differential. The input torque is split according to , then the torque required to bring both outputs to a common angular velocity within one step is transferred from the faster output to the slower one, scaled by . A stiffness of 1 is a full lock; 0 leaves the differential open. This provides better traction but potentially makes steering more difficult.
OpenTorqueSplit(System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single, System.Single@, System.Single@) Calculates torque split for an open differential. Simply splits the input torque between outputs according to the bias parameter. An open differential allows wheels to rotate at different speeds during turns, providing no resistance to wheel speed differences.
RefreshSplitTorqueDelegate Refreshes the based on the current of the differential. Ensures that the correct torque split method is used for the selected differential type. If the type is Custom but no delegate is assigned, reverts to Open and logs a warning.

DifferentialType
Defines the type of differential behavior for torque distribution between left and right wheels.
Fields
Name Description
Custom Custom differential that uses a custom delegate to determine torque distribution. Requires a delegate to be set.
LimitedSlip Limited slip differential that provides controlled resistance to wheel speed differences. Balances traction and steering ability.
Locked Locked differential that forces both wheels to rotate at the same speed. Provides maximum traction but can make steering difficult.
Open Open differential that allows wheels to rotate at different speeds during turns. Provides no resistance to wheel speed differences.

VehicleFollower
Main vehicle follower camera system that handles camera positioning, rotation, and field of view adjustments.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-applytargetsjob](ApplyTargetsJob) Job responsible for applying calculated camera targets to the actual camera transforms. This job handles the final positioning, rotation, and field of view adjustments for the camera system.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-calculationsjob](CalculationsJob) Job responsible for calculating various camera effects and behaviors. This job handles stunt factors, height/distance calculations, shaking effects, pulse effects, and impact handling.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-inputsaccess](InputsAccess) Struct that provides access to input data for the vehicle follower camera system. This struct contains all the input values needed for camera control including mouse movement, touch input, camera view controls, and various button states.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-inputssheet](InputsSheet) Class responsible for collecting and processing all input data for the vehicle follower camera system. This class handles both Unity's legacy input system and the new Input System, processes mouse/touch input, and manages mobile input presets for cross-platform camera control.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-obstaclesdetectionjob](ObstaclesDetectionJob) Job responsible for detecting obstacles and adjusting camera positioning to avoid collisions. This job analyzes obstacle data and modifies camera transforms to maintain clear line of sight.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-orbitjob](OrbitJob) Job responsible for handling camera orbit controls and mouse/keyboard input processing. This job manages horizontal and vertical orbit angles, input smoothing, and orbit timeouts.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-shakingjob](ShakingJob) Job responsible for applying camera shake effects to multiple camera transforms in parallel. This job processes various shake types (impact, NOS, speed, off-road, slip) and applies them to camera positions for enhanced immersion and feedback.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-statsaccess](StatsAccess) Struct that contains all the statistics and state data for the vehicle follower camera system. This struct holds camera configuration, orbit angles, shake effects, pulse effects, and various calculated values that are used across multiple jobs to coordinate camera behavior.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-updatecamerajob](UpdateCameraJob) Job responsible for updating camera positions and rotations for multiple cameras in parallel. This job handles both pivot cameras (fixed positions) and follower cameras (dynamic positioning) and applies orbit effects and pulse modifications to create smooth camera movement.
[#mvc-core-vehiclefollower-updatejob](UpdateJob) Job responsible for managing camera switching, showcase mode, and overall camera system state. This job handles camera transitions, showcase camera behavior, and coordinates the overall camera system workflow including smooth transitions and timeout management.
Fields
Name Description
autoSetDimensions Whether to automatically calculate camera dimensions based on vehicle size. When enabled, camera height and distance will be automatically adjusted based on vehicle bounding box. When disabled, manual height and distance values will be used.
cameraInstances Array of Unity Camera components for each camera in the system. Used for applying field of view changes and other camera-specific operations.
cameras Array of camera configurations for the current vehicle. Automatically rebuilt when cameras change to ensure consistency.
camerasAccess Native array of camera access data for job system processing. Provides efficient access to camera configuration data without creating garbage.
currentRotations Native array of current rotation values for each camera. Used by the job system to track current camera rotation state.
followerPivotsIndexes Native array mapping camera indices to pivot indices for pivot cameras. Used by the job system to efficiently access pivot data for each camera.
ignorePivotsSmoothing Whether to ignore smoothing for pivot cameras during transitions. When enabled, pivot cameras will switch instantly while follower cameras still use smooth transitions.
inputs Input sheet instance for processing all input data. Handles mouse, touch, keyboard, and mobile input for camera control.
inputsAccess Input access data for job system processing. Provides efficient access to input values without creating garbage.
instance Static reference to the singleton VehicleFollower instance. Used to provide global access to the vehicle follower system. Set during initialization and cleared when the instance is destroyed.
obstacleHits Array of raycast hits for obstacle detection. Used to detect obstacles that the camera should avoid for collision prevention.
pivotsAccess Native array of pivot access data for job system processing. Provides efficient access to pivot transform data without creating garbage.
setUserFieldOfView Whether to use the user-defined field of view instead of calculated values. When true, the camera will use userFieldOfView instead of automatic calculations.
shakePrecision The precision level for shake effects in the camera system. Determines whether to use simple or advanced shake calculations.
sortedPivots Cached copy of the chassis follower pivots ordered by the ToolkitSettings camera order. Rebuilt whenever no longer matches the chassis array.
sortedPivotsSource The chassis pivots array instance the cache was built from. Used to detect target changes or chassis pivot refreshes and rebuild the ordered cache.
stats Statistics and state data for the camera system. Contains all the calculated values used across multiple jobs for camera behavior.
targetPositions Native array of target position values for each camera. Used by the job system to calculate smooth camera positioning.
targetRotations Native array of target rotation values for each camera. Used by the job system to calculate smooth camera rotations.
useSmoothCameraChange Whether to use smooth transitions when switching between cameras. When enabled, camera changes will interpolate smoothly over the specified transition time.
userFieldOfView User-defined field of view value for manual camera control. Can be set by external systems to override automatic field of view calculations.
vehicleInstance Reference to the vehicle instance being followed by the camera system. Cached to avoid repeated lookups and enable efficient access to vehicle data.

Name Description

Restart Restarts and reinitializes the VehicleFollower, resetting all state and reattaching to the current vehicle. This is called on Awake and can be called manually to force a reinitialization.
SetFieldOfView(System.Boolean) Enables or disables the use of the user-defined field of view.
SetFieldOfView(System.Single, System.Boolean) Sets the user-defined field of view for the camera(s) and enables/disables its use.
ShakingAndObstaclesDetection Handles camera shake and obstacle detection, including raycasting for obstacles and adjusting camera positions accordingly. Schedules and completes the ShakingJob and, if needed, the ObstaclesDetectionJob.
SortPivotsBySettingsOrder(MVC.Base.VehicleFollowerPivot[]) Returns a copy of ordered by each pivot's associated camera position in Settings.Cameras (the ToolkitSettings order), using a stable sort so pivots referencing the same camera preserve their original transform order. Keeping the follower's pivot array in settings-slot order lets both the per-frame positioning (followerPivotsIndexes) and the pivot cycling (currentPivotIndex) resolve to the correct pivot.
TryApplyCollisionShaking(Unity.Mathematics.float3) Applies a collision shake effect and reports whether the shake was accepted.
Update Unity's Update method. Handles per-frame updates for input, camera, and stats. Schedules and completes the UpdateJob for camera and pivot logic.
UpdateCameras Updates camera rotations and positions for all cameras, including trailer logic. Schedules and completes the UpdateCameraJob.

Returns a copy of ordered by each pivot's associated camera position in Settings.Cameras (the ToolkitSettings order), using a stable sort so pivots referencing the same camera preserve their original transform order. VehicleGroundMapper
VehicleGroundMapper is responsible for mapping ground types and properties for a vehicle in the Multiversal Vehicle Controller system. It detects the type of ground (terrain or collider), manages the mapping between ground layers and ground settings, and ensures that the correct physical material and ground indices are set up for the vehicle's interaction with the environment. This class is intended to be attached to GameObjects representing ground surfaces.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper-groundaccess](GroundAccess) Provides read-only access to ground module properties for efficient data transfer and physics calculations. This struct is designed for performance-critical operations and uses MarshalAs attributes for native interop.
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper-groundcontact](GroundContact) Resolved ground map and ground module data for a single wheel contact.
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper-groundmap](GroundMap) Represents a ground mapping entry that stores wetness and index information for specific ground areas. This struct is used to track environmental conditions like wetness across different ground regions.
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper-groundmodule](GroundModule) Defines a ground surface type with all its properties including physics, visual effects, audio, and materials. This struct contains comprehensive settings for how vehicles interact with different ground surfaces.
[#mvc-core-vehiclegroundmapper-groundtype](GroundType) Defines the type of ground surface detected by the vehicle ground mapper.

VehicleWheel
Represents a single vehicle wheel, handling its physics, visuals, and damage state. This class manages the wheel's collider, friction, health, and associated renderers and effects.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-drivetrain](DriveTrain) Specifies which axle the wheel is driven by in the vehicle's drivetrain. Used to determine torque direction and wheel behavior.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-editorfoldout](EditorFoldout) Represents the available foldout sections in the VehicleWheel editor UI. Used to control which section of the inspector is currently expanded.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-sfxsheet](SFXSheet) SFXSheet manages wheel-local sound effects that still need per-wheel sources. Continuous ground skid and roll loops are owned by .
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-side](Side) Indicates the lateral position of the wheel on the vehicle. Used for symmetry, mirroring, and side-specific logic.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-suspensionmodule](SuspensionModule) Represents the suspension configuration and state for a single vehicle wheel. This class encapsulates all tunable parameters for the wheel's suspension, including length, stiffness, damping, and alignment angles. It provides property accessors with validation and clamping, and supports runtime and editor-time updates.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-vfxsheet](VFXSheet) Handles all visual effects (VFX) related to a single VehicleWheel, including particle systems for ground interaction, tire damage, explosions, and ground marks. This class manages the instantiation, updating, and cleanup of these effects based on the wheel's state and the ground type.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-wheelaccess](WheelAccess) Provides a read-only, value-type snapshot of the essential configuration and physical properties of a vehicle wheel. This struct is designed for efficient access and transfer of wheel data, such as position, drive train, geometry, and tire friction curves, without exposing mutable references or implementation details. Intended for use in systems that require fast, thread-safe, or marshaled access to wheel configuration, such as physics, serialization, or analytics.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-wheelmodule](WheelModule) Represents a single wheel module for a vehicle, encapsulating all relevant data and logic for the wheel's model, rim, tire, brake components, and their relationships. Provides accessors for wheel properties, bounds, and state, and manages the connection to the parent vehicle.
[#mvc-core-vehiclewheel-wheelstatsaccess](WheelStatsAccess) Provides a read-only snapshot of the current state and statistics of a vehicle wheel. This struct is intended for efficient access to all relevant wheel data, such as position, rotation, velocities, forces, and tire/brake conditions.

MAX_DRIFT_FORWARD_FRICTION_MULTIPLIER The maximum allowed multiplier for forward friction when the wheel is in a drift state. This value increases the forward grip of the tire, allowing for tuning of drift behavior.
MAX_DRIFT_SIDEWAYS_FRICTION_MULTIPLIER The maximum allowed multiplier for sideways friction when the wheel is in a drift state. This value limits the maximum lateral grip available while drifting.
MIN_DRIFT_FORWARD_FRICTION_MULTIPLIER The minimum allowed multiplier for forward friction when the wheel is in a drift state. This value reduces the forward grip of the tire to simulate loss of traction during drifting.
MIN_DRIFT_SIDEWAYS_FRICTION_MULTIPLIER The minimum allowed multiplier for sideways friction when the wheel is in a drift state. Lower values result in less lateral grip, making the vehicle easier to slide sideways during a drift.

Methods
Name Description
AddDamageZone(MVC.Base.VehicleDamageZone) Adds a damage zone to the wheel if it is not already present. Used for tracking areas of the wheel that can be damaged.
Angles Updates the wheel's angles (caster, toe, camber) and applies steering angle to the wheel collider.
ApplyColliderConfig Builds the wheel's current physical configuration and flushes it to the backend. The backend performs its own change detection before touching the simulation.
ApplyDefaultGroundContact Applies the default first ground when a collider has no mapper but ground settings are available.
ApplyGroundContact(MVC.Core.VehicleGroundMapper.GroundContact) Applies a resolved ground contact to the wheel's current ground indices and off-road state.
Calculations Performs all per-frame calculations for the wheel, including slip, friction, and ground detection.
ClearGroundStrengths Clears blended ground strength values before writing newly resolved contact strengths.
CreateColliderBackend Creates the wheel-collider backend for the currently selected physics integration and initializes its underlying physics objects.
DamageTrigger(MVC.Base.VehicleDamageZone) Checks if the wheel is inside a damage zone and applies repair or damage as appropriate.
DamageWheel Damages the wheel, setting its tire health to zero.
DestroyColliderBackend Deinitializes and releases the wheel-collider backend, destroying any legacy collider object left behind when no backend exists.
Donuts Simulates "donut" (drifting in a circle) behavior by adjusting sideways friction based on vehicle state.
FixedUpdate Unity FixedUpdate callback. Handles all physics-related updates for the wheel.
FlushColliderInputs Writes this step's control inputs (motor torque, brake torque and steer angle) to the backend. Called at the end of the wheel's FixedUpdate pass.
GearLimiter Limits the gear torque and applies engine braking based on current speed, gear, and engine state.
GetRimMaterialEmissionColorPropertyName Gets the property name for the rim material's emission color, depending on the shader used. Caches the result for future calls.
GetWheelHit Gets the current wheel hit information from the physics system. Updates the IsGrounded property based on the result.
Handling(System.Int32) Handles wheel friction, slip, and tire health based on the current ground and slip values.
Initialize Initializes or resets all wheel-related fields and state. Destroys any existing VFX, SFX, or collider objects. Resets all cached values and prepares the wheel for a fresh setup.
LateCalculations Performs late-stage calculations for the wheel, such as updating hit information and local velocities. This is typically used for rendering and effects that require up-to-date physics data.
LateUpdate Called by Unity after all Update functions have been called. Handles late-stage calculations and updates for the wheel, including physics, rendering, sound, and visual effects.
MultiplyForwardFrictionStiffness(System.Single) Multiplies the forward friction stiffness multiplier by the absolute value of the given stiffness. This affects how much grip the wheel has in the forward direction.

FrictionModule
Fields
Name Description
asymptoteSlip The slip value (in meters) at which the friction curve reaches its asymptote (end of the curve). Beyond this slip, the friction force remains constant at .
asymptoteValue The force value at the asymptote slip (end of the friction curve). This represents the minimum friction force when the tire is sliding.
extremumSlip The slip value (in meters) at which the friction curve reaches its maximum (peak) force. This is the point of optimal grip before the tire begins to slide.
extremumValue The force value at the extremum slip (peak of the friction curve). Higher values result in more grip at the optimal slip point.
stiffness A scaling factor applied to the entire friction curve. Higher values increase the overall grip of the tire.

SuspensionModule
Represents the suspension configuration and state for a single vehicle wheel. This class encapsulates all tunable parameters for the wheel's suspension, including length, stiffness, damping, and alignment angles. It provides property accessors with validation and clamping, and supports runtime and editor-time updates.
Fields
Name Description

caster Backing field for . The caster angle of the wheel, in degrees.

length Backing field for . The total length of the suspension strut, in meters.

sideOffset Backing field for . The lateral offset of the suspension, in meters.
stiffness Backing field for . The spring stiffness of the suspension, in N/m.

toe Backing field for . The toe angle of the wheel, in degrees.

Handles all visual effects (VFX) related to a single VehicleWheel, including particle systems for ground interaction, tire damage, explosions, and ground marks. This class manages the instantiation, updating, and cleanup of these effects based on the wheel's state and the ground type.
Fields
Name Description
currentGround The index of the current ground type. -1 if not on any ground.
currentGroundMark The index of the current ground mark in the groundMarks array. -1 if none active.
damageParticleEmissionScales Original emission curves for each damage particle system and its children. Null if damage or wheel health is not enabled.
damageParticleSystemLeft The left-side damage particle system for the current ground type.
damageParticleSystemRight The right-side damage particle system for the current ground type.
damageParticleSystems Array of particle systems for each ground type, used for damaged/flat tire effects. Each ground type has two entries: left and right. Null if damage or wheel health is not enabled.
damageStateChanged True if the tire damage state has changed since the last update.
emission Cached emission module for the currently active particle system.
emissionMultiplier Multiplier applied to emission rates, based on slip, speed, or temperature.
ground The current ground module (surface type) the wheel is interacting with.
groundChanged True if the ground type has changed since the last update.
groundMarks Array of ground mark objects (e.g., skid marks) created by this wheel.
lastTireHealth Stores the last known tire health value to detect state changes.
particleEmissionScales Original emission curves for each normal ground particle system and its children.
particleSystem The currently active normal particle system for the current ground type.
particleSystems Array of particle systems for each ground type, used for normal wheel effects (e.g., dust, smoke). The index corresponds to the ground type index.
tireExplosion The particle system instance used for tire explosion effects.
tireExplosionForce The force field used in conjunction with the tire explosion effect.
velocity Cached velocity over lifetime module for the currently active damage particle system.
wheel Reference to the parent VehicleWheel.

WheelAccess
Provides a read-only, value-type snapshot of the essential configuration and physical properties of a vehicle wheel. This struct is designed for efficient access and transfer of wheel data, such as position, drive train, geometry, and tire friction curves, without exposing mutable references or implementation details. Intended for use in systems that require fast, thread-safe, or marshaled access to wheel configuration, such as physics, serialization, or analytics.
Fields
Name Description
aspect The aspect ratio of the tire (percentage of width).
brakeDiscMaterialIndex The index of the brake disc material in the brake disc renderer's material array.
diameter The diameter of the wheel (in inches).
driveTrain The drive train assignment of the wheel (Front or Rear).
height The overall height of the wheel (in meters).
hideRimEdgePerDefault True if the rim edge should be hidden by default for this wheel.
isMotorWheel True if this wheel is powered by the motor (i.e., is a drive wheel).
isSteerWheel True if this wheel is capable of steering (i.e., is a steerable wheel).
position The lateral position of the wheel on the vehicle (Left, Right, or Middle).
radius The effective radius of the wheel (in meters).
rimEdgeMaterialIndex The index of the rim edge material in the rim edge renderer's material array.
rimRadius The radius of the rim (in meters).
wheelColliderAccelerationFriction The friction curve used for acceleration (forward slip) on the wheel collider.
wheelColliderBrakeFriction The friction curve used for braking (reverse slip) on the wheel collider.
wheelColliderSidewaysFriction The friction curve used for sideways (lateral slip) on the wheel collider.
width The width of the wheel (in meters).

Provides a read-only snapshot of the current state and statistics of a vehicle wheel. This struct is intended for efficient access to all relevant wheel data, such as position, rotation, velocities, forces, and tire/brake conditions.
Fields
Name Description
brakeTemperature The current temperature of the brake (in degrees Celsius).
brakeTorque The current brake torque applied to the wheel (in Newton-meters).
brakeTorqueLoss The amount of brake torque lost due to fade or overheating (in Newton-meters).

currentWheelColliderSidewaysFriction The current sideways friction curve parameters for the wheel collider.
forwardDir The forward direction vector of the wheel in world space.
forwardFrictionStiffness The current stiffness of the forward friction curve (longitudinal).
forwardSlip The current slip value in the forward direction (longitudinal slip).
hitPoint The point where the wheel is currently making contact with the ground, in world space.
isGrounded Indicates whether the wheel is currently in contact with the ground.
isOffRoading Indicates whether the wheel is currently off-roading (not on a standard road surface).
localVelocity The velocity of the wheel in the local space of the vehicle.
motorTorque The current motor torque applied to the wheel (in Newton-meters).
position The world position of the wheel.
rimTemperature The current temperature of the rim (in degrees Celsius).
rotation The world rotation of the wheel as a quaternion.
rpm The current revolutions per minute (RPM) of the wheel.
scale The world scale of the wheel's transform.
sidewaysDir The sideways (right) direction vector of the wheel in world space.
sidewaysFrictionStiffness The current stiffness of the sideways friction curve (lateral).
sidewaysSlip The current slip value in the sideways direction (lateral slip).
speed The current linear speed of the wheel at the contact patch (in meters per second).
tireHealth The current health of the tire, typically in the range [0, 1].
tireTemperature The current temperature of the tire (in degrees Celsius).
toeAngle The toe angle of the wheel in degrees (inward/outward pointing).

Fields
Name Description
animation The backing field for the Animation property. Stores the AnimationModule instance that manages the driver's animation system.
animator Cached reference to the Animator component for performance optimization.
bounds The bounds of the target vehicle, used for calculating look-at positions and other spatial relationships.
driverIK Cached reference to the driver IK module from the target vehicle. Contains all the IK pivot points and parameters for the driver's limbs.
forceEditSecondaryPivots Flag to force editing of secondary pivot points in the editor. Used for advanced IK setup and debugging purposes.
lookAtEndPosition The ending position for the driver's look-at vector. This is the actual position where the driver's head/eyes will look.
lookAtPositionHeight The backing field for the LookAtPositionHeight property. Represents the height offset (0.0 to 1.0) for the driver's look-at position relative to the vehicle's bounds. A value of 0.0 means the driver looks at the bottom of the vehicle, while 1.0 means they look at the top.
lookAtStartPosition The starting position for the driver's look-at vector. Calculated relative to the vehicle's bounds and orientation.
previewAnimationUpdating Prevents recursive edit-mode preview evaluations when Animator.Update triggers callbacks.
problems The backing field for the Problems property. Stores the ProblemsSheet instance that handles validation and error checking.
steeringWheelAnimator Cached reference to the Animator that poses the steering wheel's IK pivots.
steeringWheelAnimatorSource The steering wheel transform the cached was resolved from. Used to detect when the vehicle's steering wheel is reassigned.
targetVehicle Cached reference to the target vehicle component for performance optimization.
Methods
Name Description
ApplyAnimatorIKTargets(System.Boolean) Applies the current driver IK targets to the animator. Runtime and edit-mode preview use this same target path.
CanPreviewAnimation(UnityEngine.Animator@) Returns whether the current edit-mode state can evaluate the driver's animator preview safely.
GetSteeringWheelAngle(MVC.Core.Vehicle.InteriorModule.ComponentModule) Calculates the signed steering wheel angle from the configured steering wheel rotation axis.
GetSteeringWheelAnimator(MVC.Core.Vehicle.InteriorModule.ComponentModule) Resolves and caches the Animator that poses the steering wheel's IK pivots.
Initialize Initializes the driver IK system by resetting the bounds to their default value. Called during restart and on initial setup.
OnAnimatorIK(System.Int32) Handles Unity's Animator IK callback, setting up the driver's IK targets for hands and feet to match the vehicle's controls.
OnDrawGizmos Keeps the driver gizmo path available without evaluating animation from every Scene view repaint. Edit-mode animation playback is advanced by the editor preview updater.
OnDrawGizmosSelected Draws additional gizmos in the Unity Editor when the object is selected. Visualizes the driver's look-at direction as an arrow for debugging and setup purposes.
PinSteeringWheelPivotAnimation Pins the steering wheel's pivot animator to the first frame of its clips. The blend tree that poses the IK pivots is driven entirely by the steering wheel angle parameter, so its clips are meant to hold a single static pose per angle and time must never advance through them. Letting it play freely makes the pivots, and therefore the driver's hands, drift between keyframes every frame. The update mode is aligned with the driver's animator so the pivots are posed in the same animation pass that the IK reads them from, rather than at the physics rate.
PreviewAnimation Refreshes the driver's edit-mode preview pose without advancing animation time. The editor preview updater supplies non-zero delta time for continuous playback.
PreviewAnimation(System.Single) Previews the driver's animation in the editor (when not in play mode). Updates the vehicle bounds, evaluates animated steering-wheel pivots, and forces the driver animator to run its IK pass.
RefreshLookAtPosition Refreshes the look-at positions for the driver's head/eyes, used for IK look-at targeting. Calculates the start and end positions for the look-at vector based on the vehicle's bounds and orientation.
RefreshSteeringWheelPivotAnimation(System.Boolean) Updates the steering wheel animator parameter and optionally evaluates it so animated IK pivots are current.
Restart Restarts and reinitializes the driver IK system. This method resets the internal state, reinitializes bounds, and prepares the driver for operation. If the target vehicle is not assigned, the method aborts early.
TryRefreshIKReferences(UnityEngine.Animator@, MVC.Core.Vehicle@, MVC.Core.Vehicle.DriverIKModule@) Refreshes cached references required for driver IK evaluation.

DisableAllBehaviours Disables all behaviours on the driver component to prevent further execution. This is called when critical errors are detected.
DisableDriverOnErrors Disables the driver component when animation errors are detected. This prevents the system from running with invalid animation setup.
DisableDriverOnInternalErrors Disables the driver component when internal errors are detected. This is a safety measure to prevent the system from running with critical errors.
DisableDriverOnWarnings Disables the driver component when animation warnings are detected. This prevents the system from running with missing animation components.

VehicleIKPivot
VehicleIKPivot is a specialized extension class for associating Inverse Kinematics (IK) pivot points with a Vehicle instance. This class is intended to be attached to GameObjects that serve as IK pivots for vehicles in the Multiversal Vehicle Controller system. It provides a convenient way to link IK logic or transforms to a specific vehicle, enabling advanced animation or procedural movement.
Internal
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-internal-toolkitconstants](ToolkitConstants) Contains constant values used throughout the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. This class provides centralized access to scripting symbols, configuration parameters, and preference keys used for various toolkit operations and feature detection.
[#mvc-internal-toolkitinfo](ToolkitInfo) Provides information about the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit including version, license type, contact information, and setup status. This class serves as a central repository for toolkit metadata and configuration details.
[#mvc-internal-toolkitprebuild](ToolkitPreBuild) Handles pre-build initialization and validation for the MVC toolkit. This class runs automatically before scene load to ensure proper setup and configuration.
[#mvc-internal-toolkitprefs](ToolkitPrefs) Provides a custom preference system for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. Offers type-safe storage and retrieval of various data types including strings, numbers, booleans, flags, and custom structs. Uses JSON serialization for complex types and file-based storage outside of Unity's PlayerPrefs system. All filesystem access is gated behind . Mutating APIs ( / ) do not exist in player builds, and read APIs return their default values — keeping the runtime assembly free of for restricted platforms (Switch, PS5, Xbox GDK, WebGL).

ToolkitUnityPackages
Utility class for managing Unity package imports and sample package installations. This class handles the discovery, filtering, and installation of sample packages based on the current render pipeline (BIRP, URP, HDRP) and provides menu items for importing specific demo packages.
Fields
Name Description
GETTING_STARTED_DEMO_MOBILE_PACKAGE Package identifier for the mobile-specific Getting Started Demo package. Contains mobile-optimized examples and touch controls.
GETTING_STARTED_DEMO_PACKAGE Package identifier for the main Getting Started Demo package. Contains basic vehicle controller examples and tutorials.
TEXT_MESH_PRO_ESSENTIALS_PACKAGE_OLD Path to the TextMeshPro Essential Resources package. Required dependency for UI text rendering in the demo packages.
cachedPackageRoot Cached MVC package root, resolved on first access by . Re-validated on each call to handle the package being moved while the editor is open.
renderPipelinePackageTokens Array of tokens used to identify render pipeline-specific packages. Used to filter packages based on the current render pipeline (BIRP, URP, HDRP). Note: "birp" appears twice - this may be a typo that should be "birp" and "urp".
unityPackagesToImport Queue of Unity packages waiting to be imported. Used for batch importing multiple packages in sequence.
waitForUnityPackageImport Flag indicating whether the system is currently waiting for a package import to complete. Prevents multiple simultaneous imports and ensures proper sequencing.
Methods
Name Description
CancelImportingUnityPackages Cancels the current package import process and cleans up resources. Unsubscribes from events, resets flags, and clears saved preferences.
CheckForUnityPackagesToImport Checks for pending Unity package imports on editor startup. This method is called automatically when the editor loads and resumes any interrupted package import operations that were saved in preferences.
GetDirectoryPath(System.String) Gets the path to a specific directory within the MVC package.
GetPackageNameWithoutExtension(System.String) Extracts the package name from a package file path, removing the file extension and limiting the name to the first 4 dot-separated parts for consistency.
GetPackageRoot Resolves the MVC package root by locating a whose field starts with AND whose directory contains both and as siblings. Two independent checks (name + folder fingerprint) guarantee no false positive from any unrelated in the project. Works regardless of whether the package lives under or , and across the source/Pro/Community variants.
GetRequiredSamplePackages(System.String, System.Collections.Generic.List{System.String}) Finds all Unity packages that match the specified package name. Matches both exact names and names that start with the package name followed by a dot.
GetSamplePackages(Utilities.Utility.RenderPipeline) Retrieves a list of sample packages compatible with the specified render pipeline. Filters packages from the Samples~ directory based on render pipeline compatibility.
GetSetupPackages(Utilities.Utility.RenderPipeline) Retrieves a list of setup packages compatible with the specified render pipeline. Filters packages from the Setup~ directory based on render pipeline compatibility.
GetTextMeshProEssentialsPackages Returns the TMP Essential Resources unitypackage paths that actually exist on disk. Handles both legacy (com.unity.textmeshpro) and new (com.unity.ugui) package locations — whichever is present in the current Unity version.

ImportUnityPackageSuccess(System.String) Handles successful completion of a package import. Resets the wait flag to allow the next package to be imported.
ImportUnityPackageSuccessCancel(System.String) Handles cancellation of a package import by the user. Logs the cancellation and sets a flag to fix missing components.

ToolkitConstants
Contains constant values used throughout the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. This class provides centralized access to scripting symbols, configuration parameters, and preference keys used for various toolkit operations and feature detection.
Fields
Name Description
CHANGE_LOG_PREFIX Prefix used for changelog preference keys. Combined with version numbers to create unique keys for each changelog entry.
COMMUNITY_SCRIPTING_SYMBOL Scripting symbol constant for the Community edition of MVC. Used to conditionally compile code specific to the Community license tier.
DONT_REMIND_ASSET_REVIEW Preference key for tracking whether the user has been reminded about asset reviews. Used to control the frequency of review reminder popups.
DONT_REMIND_AUDIO_SETTINGS_ISSUES Preference key for tracking whether the user has been reminded about audio settings issues. Used to prevent repeated notifications about audio configuration problems.
DONT_REMIND_WHEEL_PHYSICS_CHANGE_WARNING Preference key for tracking whether the wheel physics change warning should be hidden. Used to avoid repeatedly warning users when switching between wheel physics integrations.
FORCE_FIX_MISSING_COMPONENTS Preference key for forcing the repair of missing components during setup. When set, the toolkit will automatically attempt to fix missing component references.
IMPORTING_UNITY_PACKAGES Preference key indicating that Unity packages are currently being imported. Used to prevent conflicts during the import process and show appropriate UI states.
INSTALLER Preference key for storing installer-related information. Used to track installation method and configuration details.
INSTALL_PLATFORM Preference key for storing the target platform installation status. Tracks which platforms (Windows, Mac, Linux, etc.) are currently supported.
INSTALL_RENDER_PIPELINE Preference key for storing the render pipeline installation status. Tracks which render pipeline (URP, HDRP, Built-in) is currently installed.
INSTALL_VERSION Preference key for storing the installed version of MVC. Used for version checking and update notifications.
LAST_VEHICLE_CONFIG_EXPORT_PATH Preference key for the folder last used to export a vehicle configuration file. Used to reopen the file panel where the user left off.
LAST_VEHICLE_CONFIG_IMPORT_PATH Preference key for the folder last used to import a vehicle configuration file. Used to reopen the file panel where the user left off.
PRO_SCRIPTING_SYMBOL Scripting symbol constant for the Pro edition of MVC. Used to conditionally compile code specific to the Pro license tier.
REVIEW_POPUP_PROBABILITY Probability value (0.0 to 1.0) for showing the asset review popup to users. Set to 0.1 (10%) to control the frequency of review prompts.
SETUP_DONE Preference key indicating whether the initial setup process has been completed. Used to determine if the setup wizard should be shown to new users.

ToolkitPrefs
Provides a custom preference system for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. Offers type-safe storage and retrieval of various data types including strings, numbers, booleans, flags, and custom structs. Uses JSON serialization for complex types and file-based storage outside of Unity's PlayerPrefs system. All filesystem access is gated behind . Mutating APIs ( / ) do not exist in player builds, and read APIs return their default values — keeping the runtime assembly free of for restricted platforms (Switch, PS5, Xbox GDK, WebGL).
Types
Name Description

Name Description
defaultEncoding The text encoding used for reading and writing preference files. Set to UTF-8 for proper Unicode support and cross-platform compatibility.
prefsPath The base directory path where preference files are stored. Located in the project root directory under "MVC Prefs" folder.

Utilities
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-utilities-beziercurve](BezierCurve) Represents a cubic Bezier curve with 4 control points. Provides efficient evaluation of position, velocity, acceleration, and jolt at any parameter t. Uses pre-computed polynomial coefficients for optimal performance.
[#mvc-utilities-curvepoint](CurvePoint) Represents a complete point on a curve with position, orientation, and geometric properties. Contains all necessary information for rendering, physics calculations, and vehicle behavior. Can be created from any curve type that implements ISpline.
[#mvc-utilities-hermitecurve](HermiteCurve) Represents a cubic Hermite curve with 4 control parameters (2 points + 2 velocities). Provides efficient evaluation of position, velocity, acceleration, and jolt at any parameter t. Uses pre-computed polynomial coefficients for optimal performance. Hermite curves are defined by endpoints and their tangent vectors (velocities).
[#mvc-utilities-icurve](ICurve) Extended interface for cubic spline types that inherit from ISpline. Provides additional functionality for curves with 4 control points.
[#mvc-utilities-ispline](ISpline) Base interface for all spline types in the MVC system. Defines the common contract for curve evaluation, properties, and operations.
[#mvc-utilities-linearline](LinearLine) Represents a linear line segment between two points. Implements ISpline interface for consistency with other curve types. Provides efficient evaluation and utility methods for straight line segments.
[#mvc-utilities-particleemissionscalegroup](ParticleEmissionScaleGroup) Captures and reapplies particle emission rates and optional start-color alpha from their original values.
[#mvc-utilities-spacedcurvepoint](SpacedCurvePoint) Represents a curve point with an associated parameter value. Used for storing curve points at specific parameter values, typically for distance-based sampling. Combines a CurvePoint with its corresponding t parameter for efficient lookup and interpolation.
[#mvc-utilities-vehicleaiextensions](VehicleAIExtensions) Provides a set of extension methods for working with vehicle AI path curves and navigation mesh settings. Includes utilities for converting between curve types, generating distance tables, sampling points, and more.
[#mvc-utilities-vehiclevfxculling](VehicleVFXCulling) Shared active-camera VFX culling helper used by vehicle, wheel, and wheel-spin effects.
[#mvc-utilities-vehiclevfxcullingstate](VehicleVFXCullingState) Resolved VFX culling state for one vehicle or effect bounds.

[#mvc-utilities-internal-toolkitdebug](ToolkitDebug) Provides enhanced debugging functionality for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. All log messages are prefixed with the toolkit name for easy identification in Unity's console.

[#mvc-utilities-internal-toolkitreflection](ToolkitReflection) Provides reflection utilities for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. Enables runtime type discovery and assembly inspection for dynamic functionality and plugin systems.

ToolkitNetworking
Provides networking utilities for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller toolkit. Includes device identification, network interface enumeration, and certificate handling for secure communications and device fingerprinting.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-utilities-internal-toolkitnetworking-bypasscertificate](BypassCertificate) Custom certificate handler that bypasses SSL certificate validation. Used for development and testing scenarios where self-signed certificates are encountered. WARNING: This should not be used in production environments for security reasons.
Methods
Name Description
GetDeviceID Gets a unique device identifier for the current device. Attempts to use device name first, then device unique identifier, falling back to unsupported identifier.
GetIPAddresses Gets all IP addresses associated with the current device. Resolves the hostname and returns all associated IP addresses, ordered by address family and string representation.
GetPhysicalAddresses Gets all physical (MAC) addresses from network interfaces on the current device. Filters out unknown interface types and invalid addresses, returning only valid 6-byte MAC addresses.
GetDeviceID
Gets a unique device identifier for the current device. Attempts to use device name first, then device unique identifier, falling back to unsupported identifier.
Returns A string representing the device identifier, or unsupported identifier if none available.
GetIPAddresses
Gets all IP addresses associated with the current device. Resolves the hostname and returns all associated IP addresses, ordered by address family and string representation.
Returns An enumerable collection of IP addresses as strings.
GetPhysicalAddresses
Gets all physical (MAC) addresses from network interfaces on the current device. Filters out unknown interface types and invalid addresses, returning only valid 6-byte MAC addresses.
Returns An enumerable collection of MAC addresses in XX-XX-XX-XX-XX-XX format.
BypassCertificate
Custom certificate handler that bypasses SSL certificate validation. Used for development and testing scenarios where self-signed certificates are encountered. WARNING: This should not be used in production environments for security reasons.

Name Description

Always validates certificates as true, effectively bypassing SSL validation.

EngineMixersGroup
Fields
Name Description
engine The used for routing engine sound effects. Assign this to control the mixing, effects, and output volume of engine audio.
exhaust The used for routing exhaust sound effects. Assign this to control the mixing, effects, and output volume of exhaust audio.
MixersGroup
Fields
Name Description
NOS The used for routing nitrous oxide system (NOS) sound effects, such as activation, purge, or boost noises.
brakeEffects The used for routing brake-related sound effects, such as brake squeal, ABS, or brake lockup. This field was formerly serialized as "brakesEffects".
chargersEffects The used for routing sound effects related to forced induction systems, such as superchargers and turbochargers. This group can be used to apply effects or volume control to all charger-related audio.
environmentalEffects The used for routing environmental sound effects, such as wind, rain, gravel, or other ambient vehicle-related sounds.
exhaustEffects The used for routing exhaust sound effects, such as engine exhaust noise, backfires, and pops. Assign this to control the mixing, effects, and output volume of exhaust audio.
supercharger The used for routing supercharger-specific sound effects, such as whine or bypass valve noises. Allows for separate processing from other charger effects.
transmission The used for routing transmission-related sound effects, such as gear shifts, clutch engagement, and drivetrain whine.
turbocharger The used for routing turbocharger-specific sound effects, such as spool, flutter, or blow-off valve noises. Allows for separate processing from other charger effects.
wheelEffects The used for routing wheel-related sound effects, such as tire screech, rolling noise, or debris impacts.

BezierCurve
Represents a cubic Bezier curve with 4 control points. Provides efficient evaluation of position, velocity, acceleration, and jolt at any parameter t. Uses pre-computed polynomial coefficients for optimal performance.
Methods
Name Description
Acceleration(System.Single) Calculates the acceleration (second derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: B''(t) = at0 + t*at1
Bounds Calculates the bounding box that contains the entire Bezier curve. Uses the convex hull property of Bezier curves for accurate bounds.
Evaluate(System.Single) Evaluates the Bezier curve at parameter t to get the position. Uses pre-computed coefficients for efficient evaluation: B(t) = bt0 + t*bt1 + t²*bt2 + t³*bt3
GetPoint(System.Single) Gets a complete curve point with position, orientation, and properties at parameter t.
Jolt Gets the jolt/jerk (third derivative) of the Bezier curve. For cubic Bezier curves, this is constant across the entire curve.
Offset(Unity.Mathematics.float3) Offsets all control points by the specified vector. Useful for moving the entire curve in 3D space.
RefreshCoefficients Calculates and caches all polynomial coefficients for efficient curve evaluation. Called automatically whenever control points are modified. Coefficients are computed for: - Position: B(t) = bt0 + t*bt1 + t²*bt2 + t³*bt3 - Velocity: B'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2 - Acceleration: B''(t) = at0 + t*at1 - Jolt: B'''(t) = jt0 (constant)
Velocity(System.Single) Calculates the velocity (first derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: B'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2
Width(System.Single) Interpolates the width at parameter t between start and end widths.

CurvePoint
Represents a complete point on a curve with position, orientation, and geometric properties. Contains all necessary information for rendering, physics calculations, and vehicle behavior. Can be created from any curve type that implements ISpline.
Fields
Name Description
MAX_BANK_SIN The steepest bank the corner limit will credit, keeping its tangent finite.
MIN_BANK_DENOMINATOR The smallest denominator the banked corner limit may use, guarding the case where the bank is steep enough that friction alone would hold the vehicle at any speed.
MIN_KAPPA The curvature below which the curve is treated as straight.
MIN_LOAD_FACTOR The smallest normal load factor a crest may leave, keeping the target velocity finite and positive where a crest is sharp enough to unload the vehicle completely.
MIN_SPEED_SQR The squared curve velocity below which a point is treated as degenerate.
curvature Curvature (kappa) at this point. Measures how much the curve bends at this location. Always positive.
forward Forward direction (tangent) at this curve point. Normalized vector pointing in the direction of curve progression.
lateralCurvature The part of the curvature that bends the curve about , signed positive when the curve turns towards . This is the part a vehicle corners against, so it is what limits cornering speed.
position 3D position of this point on the curve.
radius Radius of curvature at this point. Inverse of curvature (kappa). Infinite for straight lines.
right Right direction (binormal) at this curve point. Normalized vector pointing to the right relative to forward and up.
rotation Rotation quaternion representing the orientation at this curve point. Calculated from forward and up vectors using LookRotationSafe.
up Up direction (normal) at this curve point. Normalized vector pointing upward, perpendicular to forward and right.
verticalCurvature The part of the curvature that bends the curve in the vertical plane, signed positive over a crest and negative through a dip. This does not demand cornering grip, it changes how hard the vehicle is pressed into the surface, so it raises or lowers the grip available.
width Width of the curve at this point. Interpolated between start and end widths of the source curve.
Methods
Name Description

ResolveFrame(Unity.Mathematics.float3, Unity.Mathematics.float3, Unity.Mathematics.float3@, Unity.Mathematics.float3@) Resolves an orthonormal frame from a tangent and a reference up vector. HermiteCurve
Represents a cubic Hermite curve with 4 control parameters (2 points + 2 velocities). Provides efficient evaluation of position, velocity, acceleration, and jolt at any parameter t. Uses pre-computed polynomial coefficients for optimal performance. Hermite curves are defined by endpoints and their tangent vectors (velocities).
Methods
Name Description
Acceleration(System.Single) Calculates the acceleration (second derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: H''(t) = at0 + t*at1
Bounds Calculates the bounding box that contains the entire Hermite curve. Uses the control polygon for accurate bounds calculation.
Evaluate(System.Single) Evaluates the Hermite curve at parameter t to get the position. Uses pre-computed coefficients for efficient evaluation: H(t) = ht0 + t*ht1 + t²*ht2 + t³*ht3
GetPoint(System.Single) Gets a complete curve point with position, orientation, and properties at parameter t.
Jolt Gets the jolt/jerk (third derivative) of the Hermite curve. For cubic Hermite curves, this is constant across the entire curve.
Offset(Unity.Mathematics.float3) Offsets all control points by the specified vector. Velocities are not affected by translation.
RefreshCoefficients Calculates and caches all polynomial coefficients for efficient curve evaluation. Called automatically whenever control points or velocities are modified. Coefficients are computed for: - Position: H(t) = ht0 + t*ht1 + t²*ht2 + t³*ht3 - Velocity: H'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2 - Acceleration: H''(t) = at0 + t*at1 - Jolt: H'''(t) = jt0 (constant)
Velocity(System.Single) Calculates the velocity (first derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: H'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2
Width(System.Single) Interpolates the width at parameter t between start and end widths.
Acceleration(System.Single)
Calculates the acceleration (second derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: H''(t) = at0 + t*at1
Returns Acceleration vector at parameter t.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Parameter t ranging from 0 to 1.
Bounds
Calculates the bounding box that contains the entire Hermite curve. Uses the control polygon for accurate bounds calculation.
Returns Bounds containing the Hermite curve.
Evaluate(System.Single)
Evaluates the Hermite curve at parameter t to get the position. Uses pre-computed coefficients for efficient evaluation: H(t) = ht0 + t*ht1 + t²*ht2 + t³*ht3
Returns Position on the Hermite curve at parameter t.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Parameter t ranging from 0 to 1, where 0 is start and 1 is end.
GetPoint(System.Single)
Gets a complete curve point with position, orientation, and properties at parameter t.
Returns CurvePoint containing all curve information at parameter t.
Parameter Type Description
System.Single Parameter t ranging from 0 to 1.
Jolt
Gets the jolt/jerk (third derivative) of the Hermite curve. For cubic Hermite curves, this is constant across the entire curve.
Returns Constant jolt vector.
Offset(Unity.Mathematics.float3)
Offsets all control points by the specified vector. Velocities are not affected by translation.
Parameter Type Description
Unity.Mathematics.float3 Vector to offset all control points by.

Calculates and caches all polynomial coefficients for efficient curve evaluation. Called automatically whenever control points or velocities are modified. Coefficients are computed for: - Position: H(t) = ht0 + t*ht1 + t²*ht2 + t³*ht3 - Velocity: H'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2 - Acceleration: H''(t) = at0 + t*at1 - Jolt: H'''(t) = jt0 (constant)
Velocity(System.Single)
Calculates the velocity (first derivative) at parameter t. Uses pre-computed coefficients: H'(t) = vt0 + t*vt1 + t²*vt2

VehicleWheelSpin
Component that creates a wheel spin effect by rendering multiple instances of the wheel mesh with different rotations to simulate motion blur during wheel rotation.
Types
Name Description
[#mvc-vfx-vehiclewheelspin-spinmaterialmodule](SpinMaterialModule) Manages the materials used for the wheel spin effect, including runtime and shared materials, and provides utility methods for material management and validation.
[#mvc-vfx-vehiclewheelspin-vehiclewheelspincullingstate](VehicleWheelSpinCullingState) Resolved runtime culling state for one wheel spin effect.
Fields
Name Description
blurAlphaOffset The backing field for . Stores the user-defined alpha offset for the wheel spin blur effect.
flipSpinMesh If true, the wheel spin mesh triangles will be flipped. This can be used to correct the rotation direction or visual appearance of the effect.
lastAlpha The last used alpha value for the spin effect. Used to detect changes and update the effect accordingly. Only included in non-community builds.
meshFilter Cached reference to the component on this GameObject. Used for mesh manipulation and rendering.
meshRenderer Cached reference to the component on this GameObject. Used for material and rendering operations.
spinColor The color used for the wheel spin effect, including alpha for transparency. Only included in non-community builds.
spinMaterials The backing field for . Stores the array of spin material modules for this wheel spin effect.
spinMesh The mesh instance used for the wheel spin effect. This is a runtime copy of the original mesh, manipulated for visual effects. Only included in non-community builds.
vehicleInstance Cached reference to the parent instance. Used to avoid repeated GetComponentInParent calls.
visibilityCulling Legacy serialized visibility culling flag. Wheel Spin culling is now controlled by the global VFX culling settings.
visible Indicates whether the wheel spin effect is currently visible. Used for culling and rendering logic. Only included in non-community builds.
wheelInstance Cached reference to the associated instance. Used to avoid repeated lookups in the parent vehicle's wheel array.

ToolkitBehaviour
Base MonoBehaviour class that provides core functionality and static access to MVC toolkit components. This class serves as the foundation for all MVC toolkit behaviors and provides centralized access to essential services like settings, vehicle management, UI control, and audio.
Fields
Name Description
Awaken Flag indicating whether this component has been awakened. Used to prevent duplicate initialization in derived classes.
listener Cached reference to the audio listener component for performance optimization.
Methods
Name Description
Awake Unity lifecycle method called when the component is awakened. Initializes the audio listener reference for the toolkit.
GetOrCreateGameController Gets or creates a game controller GameObject based on the toolkit settings. This method ensures there's always a valid game controller available for the MVC system.
Awake
Unity lifecycle method called when the component is awakened. Initializes the audio listener reference for the toolkit.
GetOrCreateGameController
Gets or creates a game controller GameObject based on the toolkit settings. This method ensures there's always a valid game controller available for the MVC system.
Returns The game controller GameObject. Returns null if there are internal errors.
ToolkitBehaviourExtension`1
Generic extension class that provides a base reference to a specific ToolkitBehaviour type. This class is useful for components that need to access their parent or sibling ToolkitBehaviour components without direct inheritance.
Fields
Name Description
base Cached reference to the base ToolkitBehaviour component for performance optimization. Uses the @ symbol to avoid conflicts with the 'base' keyword.

VehicleAudioSource
VehicleAudioSource is a utility component for managing an AudioSource in the context of vehicle systems. It provides convenient methods to play, pause, stop, and control the enabled state of the AudioSource, including support for playing a clip once (optionally with a delay) and then disabling the AudioSource. This is useful for managing one-shot or event-driven audio in vehicle systems, such as engine sounds, collision effects, or other transient audio cues.
Fields
Name Description
source The AudioSource component managed by this script. This is automatically assigned in Awake().
Methods
Name Description
Awake Unity Awake callback. Ensures the AudioSource reference is assigned.
PauseAndDisable Pauses playback of the AudioSource and disables it.
PlayAndEnable Enables the AudioSource and starts playback.
PlayOnceAndDisable Plays the assigned AudioSource's clip once, disables the AudioSource after playback, and ensures any previous coroutines are stopped before starting.
PlayOnceAndDisableCoroutine(UnityEngine.AudioSource, System.Single) Coroutine that plays the AudioSource's clip once (optionally after a delay), disables looping, waits for playback to finish, then restores the original loop setting and disables the AudioSource.
PlayOnceDelayedAndDisable(System.Single) Plays the assigned AudioSource's clip once after a specified delay, disables the AudioSource after playback, and ensures any previous coroutines are stopped before starting.
ResumeFromRootTransformEditMode Restores playback state after vehicle root transform edit mode ends.
StopAndDisable Stops playback of the AudioSource and disables it.
SuspendForRootTransformEditMode Pauses the source for vehicle root transform edit mode while preserving playback state.
UnPauseAndEnable Enables the AudioSource and resumes playback if it was paused.

VehicleManager
Central manager class for the Multiversal Vehicle Controller system. Handles vehicle registration, player management, ground mapping, and global system coordination. This class serves as a singleton that manages all active vehicles, AI vehicles, and player interactions.
